  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2))
  (x : Fin 2 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M), ![x (e 0), x (e 1)] ∘ ⇑(Equiv.symm e) = x
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedKinds.perm_symm_vec : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2))
  (x : Fin 2 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M), ![x (e 0), x (e 1)] ∘ ⇑(Equiv.symm e) = x :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] e x =>
  funext fun i =>
    Exists.casesOn (Equiv.surjective e i) fun j h =>
      h ▸
        Eq.mpr (id (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (congrArg ![x (e 0), x (e 1)] (Equiv.symm_apply_apply e j))) (x (e j))))
          (match j with
          | 0 => Eq.refl (![x (e 0), x (e 1)] 0)
          | 1 => Eq.refl (![x (e 0), x (e 1)] 1))

  {

      Exists.casesOn a fun a h =>
        Exists.casesOn h fun γ h =>
          Exists.intro a

                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => x ∈ D ↔ _a)

      Exists.casesOn a fun a h =>
        Exists.casesOn h fun γ h =>
          Exists.intro a

                {
                  mp := fun a_1 =>
                    Exists.casesOn a_1 fun x h_1 =>
                      And.casesOn h_1 fun hx right =>
                        right ▸ (DiamondIntegral.Section2.openDiscCode_mem_iff_value a x γ).mpr ((h x).mp hx),

                    have hz' :=
                      DiamondIntegral.Section2.disc_underlying_subset_vf (DiamondIntegral.Section2.openDiscCode a γ) hz;
                    Exists.intro ⟨z, hz'⟩
                      ⟨(h ⟨z, hz'⟩).mpr ((DiamondIntegral.Section2.openDiscCode_mem_iff_value a ⟨z, hz'⟩ γ).mp hz),

                  this))

            (h x).mpr
              (have h2 := SpecialTransformations.Section9.vfValue_min_le_sub (x - a') (a - a');
              have h1' :=
                Eq.mpr
                  (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑γ < _a) (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedMatching.vfValue_sub_swap a a')))

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

          (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a * ↑ρ < ↑σ * w) (mul_inv_cancel₀ hσ))

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  {A : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M × DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)} {x y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M},

  {

      Exists.casesOn a fun w h =>
        Prod.casesOn (motive := fun x_1 => x_1 ∈ A ∧ x_1.swap = (y, x) → (x, y) ∈ A) w

  {A : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M × DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)}
  {ε : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M} {t₁ t₂ : DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M},
  DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.Balanced A ε t₁ t₂ →
    DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.Balanced (Prod.swap '' A)
      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCellGeometry.positionInv A ε) t₂ t₁
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedMatching.balanced_transpose : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {A : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M × DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)}
  {ε : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M} {t₁ t₂ : DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M},
  DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.Balanced A ε t₁ t₂ →
    DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.Balanced (Prod.swap '' A)
      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCellGeometry.positionInv A ε) t₂ t₁ :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {A} {ε}
    {t₁ t₂} h =>
  And.casesOn h.rvAffine fun hA₁ right =>
    And.casesOn right fun left right =>
      Exists.casesOn right fun s hs =>
        {
          first_disc :=
            Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.IsOpenDiscVF _a)
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedMatching.first_swap A)))
              h.second_disc,
          second_disc :=
            Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.IsOpenDiscVF _a)
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedMatching.second_swap A)))
              h.first_disc,
          bijective :=
            Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    Set.BijOn (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCellGeometry.positionInv A ε) _a
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.second (Prod.swap '' A)))
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedMatching.first_swap A)))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg
                    (fun _a =>
                      Set.BijOn (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCellGeometry.positionInv A ε)
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.second A) _a)
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedMatching.second_swap A)))
                (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedMatching.positionInv_bijOn h)),
          discToDisc :=
            Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.DiscToDisc _a
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCellGeometry.positionInv A ε))
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedMatching.first_swap A)))
              fun E hEA hE =>
              Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedMatching.isOpenDiscVF_iff.mp hE) fun c h_1 =>
                Exists.casesOn h_1 fun ρ hc =>
                  have hcE :=
                    (hc c).mpr
                      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑ρ < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue _a) (sub_self c)))
                        (SpecialTransformations.Section9.gamma_lt_value_zero ρ));
                  have hcA := hEA hcE;
                  let a := DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCellGeometry.positionInv A ε c;

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedMatching.jacobian_rv_eq : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

  {X : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 2 q) S}
  {ε : (Fin q → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M}
  {t : (Fin q → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RV M}
  {t₁ : (Fin q → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M}
  (H : DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedShearStages.BalancedShearInput X ε t t₁)
  (a : ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedMatching.firstFamily X).carrier) {J : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M},
  SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasMixedVFJacobianAt (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedMatching.positionMap H).toFun a
      J →
    ∀ {s : DiamondIntegral.Section2.RV M},
      DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.HasSlope
          (DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.first (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedShearStages.cell X (↑a).2))
          (ε (↑a).2) s →
        DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M J = ↑s :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} {q}
    {X} {ε} {t} {t₁} H a {J} hJ {s} hs =>
  Exists.casesOn hJ fun F h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hF right =>
      Exists.casesOn right fun A h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hpart hdet =>
          have hJ0 :=
            Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => A 0 0 = _a) (Eq.symm hdet)))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => A 0 0 = _a) (Matrix.det_fin_one A))) (Eq.refl (A 0 0)));
          have hp := hpart 0 0;
          have hcenter := SpecialTransformations.Section9.IsVFChartAt.center hF;
          Exists.casesOn hF fun ρ hρ =>
            let σ := DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedShearStages.rvRadius s;
            Exists.casesOn
              (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasVFPartialAt F (↑a).1 0 0 _a) hJ0) hp σ)
              fun δ hδ =>
              Exists.casesOn (exists_gt (max δ ρ)) fun γ hγ =>
                Exists.casesOn (SpecialTransformations.Section8.gamma_has_vf_representative γ) fun r h =>
                  And.casesOn h fun hr hval =>
                    have hrδ :=
                      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑δ < _a) hval))
                        (LE.le.trans_lt
                          (have this := le_max_left δ ρ;
                          this)
                          hγ);
                    let a₁ := (↑a).1;
                    let x := a₁ + Pi.single 0 r;
                    have hx := fun i =>
                      Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrArg
                            (fun _a => ↑ρ < SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom (x _a - (↑a).1 _a))
                            (Fin.fin_one_eq_zero i)))
                        (id
                          (Eq.mpr
                            (id
                              (congrArg
                                (fun _a =>
                                  ↑ρ < SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom ((↑a).1 0 + _a - (↑a).1 0))
                                (Pi.single_eq_same 0 r)))
                            (Eq.mpr
                              (id
                                (congrArg (fun _a => ↑ρ < SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom _a)
                                  (add_sub_cancel_left ((↑a).1 0) r)))
                              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑ρ < _a) hval))
                                (LE.le.trans_lt
                                  (have this := le_max_right δ ρ;
                                  this)
                                  hγ)))));
                    Exists.casesOn (hρ x hx) fun hxA hFx =>
                      have hFx0 := Eq.symm (congrFun (congrArg Prod.fst hFx) 0);
                      have hFa0 := congrFun hcenter 0;
                      have hx0 :=
                        id

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {q : ℕ} (f : Fin q → DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M)
  (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)) (ν : Fin 2 → Fin q) (l : Fin 0 → Fin q),
  ∏ i, f (Fin.append (fun i => ν ((Equiv.symm σ) i)) l i) = f (ν 0) * f (ν 1) :=

      (congrArg (fun _a => _a = f (ν 0) * f (ν 1))
        (Fin.prod_univ_add fun i => f (Fin.append (fun i => ν ((Equiv.symm σ) i)) l i))))

        (congrFun'
          (congrArg Eq

            ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.BalancedShearStages.mem_translationTarget_iff hv H R ↑z).mp z.property)

              have hx := congrArg Prod.fst hz;
              have hw := congrArg Prod.snd hz;

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.BoundedClasses.image_compl_piece : ∀ {M : Type} {n m : ℕ} {f : (Fin n → M) → Fin m → M}
  {A P Q : Set (Fin n → M)} {C : Set (Fin m → M)},
  Set.BijOn f A C → A = P ∪ Q → Disjoint P Q → C \ f '' (A ∩ Q) = f '' (A ∩ P)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.BoundedClasses.image_compl_piece : ∀ {M : Type} {n m : ℕ} {f : (Fin n → M) → Fin m → M}
  {A P Q : Set (Fin n → M)} {C : Set (Fin m → M)},
  Set.BijOn f A C → A = P ∪ Q → Disjoint P Q → C \ f '' (A ∩ Q) = f '' (A ∩ P) :=
fun {M} {n m} {f} {A P Q} {C} hf hA hPQ =>
  Set.ext fun y =>
    {
      mp := fun a =>
        And.casesOn a fun hy hnot =>
          Exists.casesOn (hf.right.right hy) fun x h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hx right =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun y => y ∈ C → y ∉ f '' (A ∩ Q) → y ∈ f '' (A ∩ P))
                (fun hy hnot =>
                  have hx' := hA ▸ hx;
                  Or.casesOn hx' (fun hp => Exists.intro x ⟨⟨hx, hp⟩, rfl⟩) fun hq =>
                    absurd (Exists.intro x ⟨⟨hx, hq⟩, rfl⟩) hnot)
                right hy hnot,
      mpr := fun a =>
        Exists.casesOn a fun x h =>
          And.casesOn h fun left right =>
            And.casesOn left fun hx hp =>
              right ▸
                ⟨hf.left hx, fun a =>
                  Exists.casesOn a fun x' h =>
                    And.casesOn h fun left he =>
                      And.casesOn left fun hx' hq =>
                        have hxx := hf.right.left hx' hx he;
                        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun x => x ∈ A → x ∈ P → f x' = f x → False)
                          (fun hx hp he => Set.disjoint_left.mp hPQ hp hq) hxx hx hp he⟩ }
'DiamondIntegral.Section7.BoundedClasses.image_compl_piece' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.ConjugatedMaps.prepared_slice_covariant : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G : Type} [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G]
  [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G],
  M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF00 →
    ∀ {S : Set M} {n : ℕ} {e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1 + 1))}
      {A : DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondCategory.VFObject S (n + 1 + 1)}
      (F₀ : DiamondIntegral.Section6.NormalizedMeasuredContraction A.carrier A.form e)
      (b : Fin (n + 1) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)
      (t : Fin (n + 1 + 1 + A.labels) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
      ∃ α,
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.NamedRadii S t α ∧
          ∀ (x y : Fin 1 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)
            (hx :
              (Fin.snoc b (x 0), t) ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.reindexedVFSet F₀.normalization.map.image e).carrier)
            (hy :
              (Fin.snoc b (y 0), t) ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.reindexedVFSet F₀.normalization.map.image e).carrier),

              DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaMapValue F₀.preparedForm ⟨(Fin.snoc b (x 0), t), hx⟩ =
                DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaMapValue F₀.preparedForm ⟨(Fin.snoc b (y 0), t), hy⟩ :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G}
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] h00 {S} {n} {e} {A} F₀ b t =>
  let D := F₀.normalization;
  let u := fun j => t (Fin.natAdd (n + 1 + 1) j);
  Exists.casesOn (A.formCovariant u) fun α h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hα hcov =>
      Exists.intro (fun x => α (e (Fin.last (n + 1))))
        ⟨fun x =>
          Set.Definable.mono (hα (e (Fin.last (n + 1)))) fun ⦃z⦄ a =>
            Or.casesOn a (fun hz => Or.inl hz) fun h =>
              Exists.casesOn h fun j h => h ▸ Or.inr (Exists.intro (Fin.natAdd (n + 1 + 1) j) rfl),
          fun x y hx hy hxy =>
          have hb := DiamondIntegral.Section7.ConjugatedMaps.prep_bijective h00 F₀;
          Exists.casesOn (Function.Bijective.surjective hb ⟨(Fin.snoc b (x 0), t), hx⟩) fun px hpx =>
            Exists.casesOn (Function.Bijective.surjective hb ⟨(Fin.snoc b (y 0), t), hy⟩) fun py hpy =>
              have hvx :=
                Eq.trans (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ConjugatedMaps.prep_value F₀ px))
                  (congrArg Subtype.val hpx);
              have hvy :=
                Eq.trans (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ConjugatedMaps.prep_value F₀ py))
                  (congrArg Subtype.val hpy);
              have htx := congrArg Prod.snd hvx;
              have hty := congrArg Prod.snd hvy;
              have hux :=
                funext fun j =>
                  have h := congrFun htx (Fin.natAdd (n + 1 + 1) j);
                  Eq.mp
                    (congrFun'
                      (congrArg Eq
                        (Fin.append_right (fun i => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core (↑px) i)) (↑px).2 j))

                          (congrArg Eq

                        (Eq.mp
                          (congrFun'
                            (congrArg Eq

                                i))
                            (t (Fin.castAdd A.labels i)))
                          h2)));
              have hfx := congrArg Prod.fst hvx;
              have hfy := congrArg Prod.fst hvy;
              have hcoord := fun k =>
                have h1 := congrFun hfx ((Equiv.symm e) k);
                have h2 := congrFun hfy ((Equiv.symm e) k);

  Exists.intro (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfReindexLinear 1)
    ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfRelabeling_derivative hv X 1 hX p,
      have h :=
        LinearMap.ext fun x =>
          funext fun i =>
            Eq.mpr
              (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a i = LinearMap.id x i) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfReindexLinear_apply 1 x)))

        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a.det = 1) LinearMap.toMatrix'_id))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 1) Matrix.det_one)) (Eq.refl 1)))⟩

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.Corollary715.proj_of_relativelyUnary : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G : Type} [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G]
  [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {S : Set M} {n : ℕ} {e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1 + 1))}
  {A' A'' : DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondCategory.VFObject S (n + 1 + 1)}
  (F : DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondCategory.Morphism G A' A''),
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondCategory.VFRelativelyUnary F.map (e (Fin.last (n + 1))) (e (Fin.last (n + 1))) →
    ∀ (b : Fin (n + 1) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
      (∃ p ∈ A'.carrier.carrier, ∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)), b j = p.1 (e j.castSucc)) ↔
        ∃ p ∈ A''.carrier.carrier, ∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)), b j = p.1 (e j.castSucc) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G}
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {S} {n} {e} {A' A''} F hF b =>
  have hfix := fun p j =>
    have hne := fun h => Fin.castSucc_ne_last j (Equiv.injective e h);
    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (↑p).1 (e j.castSucc)) (hF p (e j.castSucc) hne)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => (↑p).1 _a = (↑p).1 (e j.castSucc))
            (Equiv.symm_apply_apply (e (Fin.last (n + 1))).cycleRange (e j.castSucc))))
        (Eq.refl ((↑p).1 (e j.castSucc))));
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun p h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hp hb =>
          Exists.intro ↑(F.map.toFun ⟨p, hp⟩)
            ⟨(F.map.toFun ⟨p, hp⟩).property, fun j => Eq.trans (hb j) (Eq.symm (hfix ⟨p, hp⟩ j))⟩,
    mpr := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun q h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hq hb =>
          Exists.casesOn (Function.Bijective.surjective F.bijective ⟨q, hq⟩) fun p hp =>
            Exists.intro ↑p
              ⟨p.property, fun j =>
                Eq.trans (hb j)
                  (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => q.1 (e j.castSucc) = _a) (Eq.symm (hfix p j))))
                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => q.1 (e j.castSucc) = (↑_a).1 (e j.castSucc)) hp))
                      (Eq.refl (q.1 (e j.castSucc)))))⟩ }

  {B : SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.Base} {k : ℕ}

  w ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.shellDomain r τ ↔
    w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex 1 (1 + r.arity) ∈
        (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.graphChart r τ).domain ∧
      SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.Proper
          (w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex 1 (1 + r.arity)) ∧

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.shell_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {B : SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.Base} {k : ℕ}
  (r : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVMeasuredCharts.Chart B k) (τ : DiamondIntegral.Section4.AnnularBlowup.Aperture r)
  (w : Fin (1 + (1 + r.arity)) → M),
  w ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.shellDomain r τ ↔
    w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex 1 (1 + r.arity) ∈
        (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.graphChart r τ).domain ∧
      SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.Proper
          (w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex 1 (1 + r.arity)) ∧
        1 <
            SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue
              (w (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.sIdx r)) ∧
          SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue (w (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.sIdx r)) ≤
            SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue
              ((w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex 1 (1 + r.arity))
                (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.aIdx r)) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {B} {k}
    r τ w =>
  have h :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section4.VariableApertureRayCancellation.annularChart_join_iff
      (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.graphChart r τ) (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.aIdx r)
      (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.graph_aperture_nonzero r τ)
      (w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex 1 (1 + r.arity))
      (w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex 1 (1 + r.arity));
  Eq.mp
    (congrArg
      (fun _a =>
        _a ∈
            (DiamondIntegral.Section4.VariableApertureRayCancellation.annularChart
                (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.graphChart r τ)
                (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.aIdx r)).domain ↔
          w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex 1 (1 + r.arity) ∈
              (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.graphChart r τ).domain ∧
            SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.Proper
                (w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex 1 (1 + r.arity)) ∧
              1 <
                  SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue
                    ((w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex 1 (1 + r.arity)) 0) ∧
                SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue
                    ((w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex 1 (1 + r.arity)) 0) ≤
                  SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue
                    ((w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex 1 (1 + r.arity))
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.aIdx r)))
      (have this := DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join_reconstruct 1 (1 + r.arity) w;
      this))

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

  (I : Set (Fin r.arity → M))
  (hI :
    SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase B
      (fun x => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv) I),
  DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.shellDomain (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.resChart r I hI)
      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.apRes τ I hI) =
    DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.shellDomain r τ ∩ DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.shellCut r I :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {B} {k}
    r τ I hI =>
  Set.ext fun w =>
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            w ∈
                DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.shellDomain
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.resChart r I hI)
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.apRes τ I hI) ↔
              _a)
          (propext
            (Set.mem_inter_iff w (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.shellDomain r τ)
              (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.shellCut r I)))))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              _a ↔
                w ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.shellDomain r τ ∧
                  w ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.shellCut r I)
            (propext
              (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.shell_iff
                (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.resChart r I hI)
                (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.apRes τ I hI) w))))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                w ∘
                        DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex 1
                          (1 + (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.resChart r I hI).arity) ∈
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.graphChart
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.resChart r I hI)
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.apRes τ I hI)).domain ∧
                    SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.Proper
                        (w ∘
                          DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex 1
                            (1 + (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.resChart r I hI).arity)) ∧
                      1 <
                          SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue
                            (w
                              (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.sIdx
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.resChart r I hI))) ∧
                        SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue
                            (w
                              (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.sIdx
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.resChart r I hI))) ≤
                          SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue
                            ((w ∘
                                DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex 1
                                  (1 + (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.resChart r I hI).arity))
                              (DiamondIntegral.Section4.BlowupChart.aIdx
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.resChart r I hI))) ↔
                  _a ∧ w ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.shellCut r I)
              (propext (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.shell_iff r τ w))))
          {
            mp := fun a =>
              And.casesOn a fun left right =>
                And.casesOn left fun left he =>
                  And.casesOn left fun hd hi =>
                    And.casesOn right fun hp right =>
                      And.casesOn right fun h1 h2 =>
                        have hw :=
                          (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.shell_iff r τ w).mpr ⟨⟨hd, he⟩, ⟨hp, ⟨h1, h2⟩⟩⟩;
                        ⟨⟨⟨hd, he⟩, ⟨hp, ⟨h1, h2⟩⟩⟩,
                          ⟨hi, DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryBlowups.shell_sorted r τ hw⟩⟩,
            mpr := fun a =>
              And.casesOn a fun left right =>
                And.casesOn left fun left right_1 =>
                  And.casesOn left fun hd he =>
                    And.casesOn right_1 fun hp right_2 =>
                      And.casesOn right_2 fun h1 h2 =>
                        And.casesOn right fun hi right => ⟨⟨⟨hd, hi⟩, he⟩, ⟨hp, ⟨h1, h2⟩⟩⟩ }))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.ElementaryComparison.cancel_gamma.{u_1} : ∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : CommGroup G]
  (a t s : G), a * t * (s * t⁻¹) = a * s :=
fun {G} [CommGroup G] a t s =>
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => a * t * _a = a * s) (mul_comm s t⁻¹)))
    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = a * s) (Eq.symm (mul_assoc (a * t) t⁻¹ s))))
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a * s = a * s) (mul_assoc a t t⁻¹)))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => a * _a * s = a * s) (mul_inv_cancel t)))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a * s = a * s) (mul_one a))) (Eq.refl (a * s))))))

      (congrArg
        (fun _a =>

    (DiamondIntegral.Section7.BoundedClasses.cls_eq_iff.mpr
      (let Xa := DiamondIntegral.Section7.FibreObjects.fibreObject T A ω a π hFa hNZ;
      let Xb := DiamondIntegral.Section7.FibreObjects.fibreObject T A ω b π hFb hNZ;

                            ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.FibreComparison.fibreObject_domain A ω a π hFa hNZ u).mp hu)),

                            ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.FibreComparison.fibreObject_domain A ω b π hFb hNZ u).mp hu)),

      p ∈ X.carrier ↔ (Fin.elim0, p.2) ∈ U.carrier ∧ ∀ (i : Fin a), DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (p.1 i) = p.2 (ν i)) →

          ∀ z ∈ X.carrier, p.2 = z.2 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M p.1 = DiamondIntegral.Section2.tupleRV M z.1),
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.preparedHeadStartRVObject X k l hT).volume.FiniteFibres →
        ∀ (t : Fin (a + k) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
          {u | (Fin.elim0, u) ∈ U.carrier ∧ (fun i => u (Fin.append ν l i)) = t}.Finite :=

    {a q k} {X} {U} {ν} hX l hT hfin t =>
  if hne : ∃ u₀, (Fin.elim0, u₀) ∈ U.carrier ∧ (fun i => u₀ (Fin.append ν l i)) = t then
    Exists.casesOn hne fun u₀ h =>
      And.casesOn h fun hu₀ ht₀ =>
        let d₀ := ⟨u₀, (DiamondIntegral.Section7.FirstStage.mem_domain_labels hX l hT u₀).mpr hu₀⟩;
        Set.Finite.subset
          (Set.Finite.image Subtype.val
            (hfin ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.preparedHeadStartRVObject X k l hT).volume.toFun d₀)))
          fun ⦃u⦄ a_1 =>

                  (id

                          (fun _a => _a = (DiamondIntegral.Section6.preparedHeadStartRVObject X k l hT).value d₀)

                      (Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrArg
                            (fun _a =>
                              (fun i =>
                                  ↑⟨u, (DiamondIntegral.Section7.FirstStage.mem_domain_labels hX l hT u).mpr hu⟩

                                _a)
                            (DiamondIntegral.Section7.FirstStage.value_labels hX l hT d₀)))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.FibreInvariance.firstSet_uniform : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G : Type} [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G]
  [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G],
  M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF00 →
    CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical →
      (∀ (x y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
          SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.VFValued.predV x y ↔ Valued.v x ≤ Valued.v y) →

              SpecialTransformations.Section3.Saturated M κ →

                  Cardinal.mk ↑S < κ →
                    DiamondIntegral.Section2.NontrivialDefinableGamma { real := S, gamma := ∅ } →
                      ∀ {n r : ℕ}
                        {Y :
                          SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet

                        {θ :
                          SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map Y
                            (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.univ
                              DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawGammaPresentation S)}
                        (D : DiamondIntegral.Section6.MeasuredOrderedProgram Y θ),
                        ∃ δ,
                          S.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV
                              {z | z 0 ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.gammaPullback {δ}} ∧

                                DiamondIntegral.Section6.Congruent (fun x => δ) a b →

                                          (DiamondIntegral.Section7.FirstStage.headStage D.program).arity).Carrier)

                                      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.FirstStage.restForm D).toFun ⟨(b, u), hb⟩ =
                                        (DiamondIntegral.Section7.FirstStage.restForm D).toFun ⟨(a, u), ha⟩ :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G}
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] h00 hc hv linear {κ} hκ hs {S} hsmall
    hΓ {n r} {Y} {θ} D =>
  let H := DiamondIntegral.Section7.FirstStage.headStage D.program;
  let V₁ := DiamondIntegral.Section7.FirstStage.restLift h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall hΓ D;
  let τ := DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvProjection V₁.map;
  have hτ := DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperCovariant.rvProjection V₁.map V₁.home.covariant;
  have hGr :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.graft_properInvariant h00 hc hκ hs hv τ
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage.contracted_proper H) hτ;
  Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section6.properInvariant_uniform_named_radius h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall hΓ hGr)
    fun δ h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hδdef right =>
      And.casesOn right fun hδ1 hInv =>
        Exists.intro δ
          ⟨hδdef,
            ⟨hδ1, fun a b hab u ha =>
              let p := ⟨(a, u), ha⟩;
              have hmem := Exists.intro p rfl;
              have hmem' := (hInv (Fin.append u (↑(τ.toFun p)).2) a b hab).mp hmem;
              Exists.casesOn hmem' fun p' hp' =>
                have hp'v := hp';
                have h1 :=
                  congrArg Prod.fst
                    (Eq.mp
                      (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (b, Fin.append u (↑(τ.toFun p)).2))
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.graft_apply hc τ p'))
                      hp'v);
                have h2 :=
                  funext fun i =>
                    Eq.mp
                      (congr (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_left (↑p').2 (↑(τ.toFun p')).2 i))
                        (Fin.append_left u (↑(τ.toFun p)).2 i))
                      (congrFun
                        (congrArg Prod.snd
                          (Eq.mp
                            (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (b, Fin.append u (↑(τ.toFun p)).2))
                              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.graft_apply hc τ p'))
                            hp'v))
                        (Fin.castAdd (DiamondIntegral.Section7.FirstStage.restData D).arity i));
                have h3 :=
                  funext fun i =>
                    Eq.mp
                      (congr (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_right (↑p').2 (↑(τ.toFun p')).2 i))
                        (Fin.append_right u (↑(τ.toFun p)).2 i))
                      (congrFun
                        (congrArg Prod.snd
                          (Eq.mp
                            (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (b, Fin.append u (↑(τ.toFun p)).2))
                              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.graft_apply hc τ p'))
                            hp'v))
                        (Fin.natAdd (DiamondIntegral.Section7.FirstStage.headStage D.program).arity i));
                have hb :=
                  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (_a, u) ∈ H.contracted.carrier) (Eq.symm h1)))
                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ((↑p').1, _a) ∈ H.contracted.carrier) (Eq.symm h2))) p'.property);
                Exists.intro hb
                  (have hpp := Subtype.ext (Prod.ext h1 h2);
                  have hmap :=
                    Subtype.ext
                      (Prod.ext (funext fun i => Fin.elim0 i)
                        (id
                          (Eq.mpr
                            (id
                              (congrArg
                                (fun _a =>
                                  _a = (↑((DiamondIntegral.Section7.FirstStage.restData D).program.toMap.toFun p)).2)
                                (Eq.symm (V₁.labels ⟨(b, u), hb⟩))))
                            (Eq.mpr
                              (id (congrArg (fun _a => (↑(V₁.map.toFun ⟨(b, u), hb⟩)).2 = _a) (Eq.symm (V₁.labels p))))
                              (Eq.mpr
                                (id (congrArg (fun _a => (↑(V₁.map.toFun _a)).2 = (↑(V₁.map.toFun p)).2) (Eq.symm hpp)))
                                (id h3))))));
                  id
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            D.rvForm.toFun _a =
                              D.rvForm.toFun
                                ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.FirstStage.restProgram D.program).toMap.toFun p))
                          hmap))
                      (Eq.refl
                        (D.rvForm.toFun
                          ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.FirstStage.restProgram D.program).toMap.toFun p)))))⟩⟩

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.FibreRestriction.isAlgebraic_of_finSucc_root : ∀ {m : ℕ} {F : Type u_1} [inst : Field F]
  {K L : Subfield F},

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.FibreRestriction.isAlgebraic_of_finSucc_root.{u_1} : ∀ {m : ℕ} {F : Type u_1}
  [inst : Field F] {K L : Subfield F},
  K ≤ L →
    ∀ (b : Fin m → F),
      (∀ (j : Fin m), b j ∈ L) →
        ∀ (R : Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin m) ↥K)),
          MvPolynomial.eval₂ K.subtype b R.leadingCoeff ≠ 0 →
            ∀ (x : F), Polynomial.eval₂ (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom K.subtype b) x R = 0 → IsAlgebraic (↥L) x :=
fun {m} {F} [Field F] {K L} hKL b hb R hlead x hx =>
  let bL := fun j => ⟨b j, hb j⟩;
  let φ := MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (Subfield.inclusion hKL) bL;
  have hφR :=
    MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
      (fun a =>
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congr (congrArg Eq (congrArg (⇑L.subtype) (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C (Subfield.inclusion hKL) bL a)))
              (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C K.subtype b a)))
          (Eq.refl (L.subtype ((Subfield.inclusion hKL) a))))
      fun i =>
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congr (congrArg Eq (congrArg (⇑L.subtype) (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X' (Subfield.inclusion hKL) bL i)))
            (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X' K.subtype b i)))
        (Eq.refl (L.subtype (bL i)));
  Exists.intro (Polynomial.map φ R)
    ⟨fun h0 =>
      hlead
        (have h1 :=
          have h := Polynomial.coeff_map φ R.natDegree;
          Eq.symm
            (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a = φ (R.coeff R.natDegree)) (Polynomial.coeff_zero R.natDegree))
              (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a.coeff R.natDegree = φ (R.coeff R.natDegree)) h0) h));
        have h2 := RingHom.congr_fun hφR R.leadingCoeff;
        Eq.symm
          (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom K.subtype b) R.leadingCoeff) (map_zero L.subtype))
            (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => L.subtype _a = (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom K.subtype b) R.leadingCoeff) h1)
              (Eq.mp
                (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom K.subtype b) R.leadingCoeff)
                  (RingHom.comp_apply L.subtype φ R.leadingCoeff))
                h2)))),
      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 0) (Polynomial.aeval_def x (Polynomial.map φ R))))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 0) (Polynomial.eval₂_map φ (algebraMap (↥L) F) x)))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => Polynomial.eval₂ (_a.comp φ) x R = 0) (Subfield.algebraMap_ofSubfield L)))
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => Polynomial.eval₂ _a x R = 0) hφR)) hx)))⟩

                                      (hfin' :

                                        (f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map X X') →
                                          DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperCovariantHomeomorphism f →

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.GoodPoints.exists_grid_nonzero : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [Finite σ] [inst : Field F]
  (P : MvPolynomial σ F),
  P ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (a : σ → F) (C : Finset F), P.totalDegree < C.card → ∃ y, (∀ (i : σ), y i ∈ C) ∧ (MvPolynomial.eval (a + y)) P ≠ 0
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.GoodPoints.exists_grid_nonzero.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {σ : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [Finite σ]
  [inst : Field F] (P : MvPolynomial σ F),
  P ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (a : σ → F) (C : Finset F),
      P.totalDegree < C.card → ∃ y, (∀ (i : σ), y i ∈ C) ∧ (MvPolynomial.eval (a + y)) P ≠ 0 :=
fun {σ} {F} [Finite σ] [Field F] P hP a C hC =>
  Decidable.byContradiction fun h =>
    hP
      (MvPolynomial.eq_zero_of_eval_zero_at_prod_finset P (fun i => Finset.image (fun c => a i + c) C)
        (fun i =>
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => MvPolynomial.degreeOf i P < _a)
                (Finset.card_image_of_injective C (add_right_injective (a i)))))
            (lt_of_le_of_lt (MvPolynomial.degreeOf_le_totalDegree P i) hC))
        fun x hx =>
        have hy := fun i =>
          Exists.casesOn (Finset.mem_image.mp (hx i)) fun c h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hc hce =>
              Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a - a i ∈ C) (Eq.symm hce)))
                (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ C) (add_sub_cancel_left (a i) c))) hc);
        have h' :=
          Eq.mp
            (Eq.trans
              (Mathlib.Tactic.Push.not_exists._simp_1 fun y => (∀ (i : σ), y i ∈ C) ∧ (MvPolynomial.eval (a + y)) P ≠ 0)
              (forall_congr fun y =>
                Eq.trans (Mathlib.Tactic.Push.not_and_eq (∀ (i : σ), y i ∈ C) ((MvPolynomial.eval (a + y)) P ≠ 0))
                  (implies_congr (Eq.refl (∀ (i : σ), y i ∈ C)) Classical.not_not._simp_2)))
            h (fun i => x i - a i) hy;
        have hxa :=
          funext fun i =>
            of_eq_true (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (add_sub_cancel (a i) (x i))) (x i)) (eq_self (x i)));
        Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => (MvPolynomial.eval _a) P = 0) hxa) h')

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.DatumSchema.append_decomp_one : ∀ {M : Type}
  [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] {n : ℕ} (v : Fin (n + 1) → M),
  v = Fin.append (fun i => v (Fin.castAdd 1 i)) fun x => v (Fin.natAdd n 0) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] {n} v =>
  funext fun i =>
    Fin.addCases
      (fun l =>
        of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg (Eq (v (Fin.castAdd 1 l)))
              (Fin.append_left (fun i => v (Fin.castAdd 1 i)) (fun x => v (Fin.natAdd n 0)) l))
            (eq_self (v (Fin.castAdd 1 l)))))
      (fun l =>
        List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x =>
          List.finRange 1 = a →
            Fintype.complete l ≍ x →
              v (Fin.natAdd n l) =
                Fin.append (fun i => v (Fin.castAdd 1 i)) (fun x => v (Fin.natAdd n 0)) (Fin.natAdd n l))
          (Fintype.complete l)
          (fun as h =>
            List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun l =>
                ∀ (this : l ∈ Fintype.elems),
                  [] ≍ as →
                    this ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                      v (Fin.natAdd n l) =
                        Fin.append (fun i => v (Fin.castAdd 1 i)) (fun x => v (Fin.natAdd n 0)) (Fin.natAdd n l))

                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun as =>
                    this ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                      v (Fin.natAdd n ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩)) =
                        Fin.append (fun i => v (Fin.castAdd 1 i)) (fun x => v (Fin.natAdd n 0))
                          (Fin.natAdd n ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩)))
                    (fun h =>
                      of_eq_true
                        (Eq.trans
                          (congrArg (Eq (v (Fin.natAdd n 0)))
                            (Fin.append_right (fun i => v (Fin.castAdd 1 i)) (fun x => v (Fin.natAdd n 0)) 0))
                          (eq_self (v (Fin.natAdd n 0)))))
                    (eq_of_heq tail_eq))
                (eq_of_heq head_eq) (Fintype.complete l))
          (fun b {as} a h =>
            List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b =>
                [] ≍ as →
                  Fintype.complete l ≍ List.Mem.tail b a →
                    v (Fin.natAdd n l) =
                      Fin.append (fun i => v (Fin.castAdd 1 i)) (fun x => v (Fin.natAdd n 0)) (Fin.natAdd n l))

                        v (Fin.natAdd n l) =
                          Fin.append (fun i => v (Fin.castAdd 1 i)) (fun x => v (Fin.natAdd n 0)) (Fin.natAdd n l))
                    (fun a h =>
                      List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a_1 x =>
                        [] = a_1 →
                          a ≍ x →
                            v (Fin.natAdd n l) =
                              Fin.append (fun i => v (Fin.castAdd 1 i)) (fun x => v (Fin.natAdd n 0)) (Fin.natAdd n l))

                        (fun b {as} a_1 h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h)) (Eq.refl []) (HEq.refl a))
                    (eq_of_heq tail_eq) a)
                (eq_of_heq head_eq))

        ∀
          (σ :
            SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map X

              (γ : DiamondIntegral.Section6.rawGammaPresentation.Carrier),
              IsOpen {a | (a, u) ∈ X.carrier ∧ DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension σ (a, u) = γ} :=

    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] hv {S} {n r} {X} hX σ hσ u γ =>
  if h : ∃ a, (a, u) ∈ X.carrier ∧ DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension σ (a, u) = γ then
    Exists.casesOn h fun a₀ h =>
      And.casesOn h fun h₀ hγ =>
        have he :=
          Set.ext fun a =>
            { mp := And.left,
              mpr := fun ha =>
                ⟨ha,

                  have e2 := DiamondIntegral.Section6.gammaFormExtension_at σ ⟨(a₀, u), h₀⟩;

                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑_a = γ) (hσ ⟨(a, u), ha⟩ ⟨(a₀, u), h₀⟩ rfl)))
                      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = γ) (Eq.symm e2))) hγ))⟩ };

        (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues a) :=

  {
    map :=
      ⟨fun i => (a i).property,
        ⟨fun u hu =>
          Exists.intro (fun i => u (π i))
            ⟨(DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.famSchema_coordRow hc A ω π N a u fun i => u (π i)).mpr ⟨hu, rfl⟩,
              fun y h => ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.famSchema_coordRow hc A ω π N a u y).mp h).right⟩,
          ⟨fun u y h => ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.famSchema_coordRow hc A ω π N a u y).mp h).left,
            fun y hy =>
            ⟨let t' := fun j => ⟨y j, hy j⟩;
              Set.Finite.subset (Set.Finite.image SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues (hFin t')) fun ⦃u⦄ hu =>
                And.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.famSchema_coordRow hc A ω π N a u y).mp hu)

                    ∀
                      (hy :
                        ∀ (j : Fin k),
                          SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.sortEval (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.rvs k j)
                            (y j)),
                      let t' := fun j => ⟨y j, hy j⟩;

                          {x |
                            Fin.append (Fin.append (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues a) x) y ∈
                              (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.famSchema hc A ω π N).coord} →
                        u ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues '' {u | (a, u) ∈ A.carrier ∧ u ∘ π = t'})
                    (fun hy =>
                      let t' := fun j => ⟨(fun i => u (π i)) j, hy j⟩;
                      fun hu =>
                      Exists.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.famSchema_mem_row hc A ω π N a u).mp hu')
                        fun t h =>
                        And.casesOn h fun ht right =>
                          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun ⦃u⦄ =>

                                (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.famSchema hc A ω π N).row

                                (hy :

                                    SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.sortEval
                                      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.rvs k j) ((fun i => u (π i)) j)),

                                  u ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues '' {u | (a, u) ∈ A.carrier ∧ u ∘ π = t'})

      And.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.famSchema_coordRow hc A ω π N a u y).mp h) fun hu right =>

            SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.Proper y)

                  u ∈
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.famSchema hc A ω π N).row

    Or.casesOn a
      (fun hz =>
        DiamondIntegral.Section7.KernelBaseChange.subset_adjoin x
          (DiamondIntegral.Section7.KernelBaseChange.subset_adjoin b hz))

                  (id

                        ↑_a ∈
                          DiamondIntegral.Section7.KernelBaseChange.adjoin

                    DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Frozen.levels_open_of_transport._simp_1_2)))))

                  Exists.intro (↑(f.toFun p)).1 (Exists.intro p ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)⟩,
          mpr := fun a_1 =>
            Exists.casesOn a_1 fun v h =>
              And.casesOn h fun left right =>
                Exists.casesOn left fun q h =>
                  And.casesOn h fun hqv hqγ =>
                    Exists.casesOn right fun b h =>

                        And.casesOn h fun hp hfp =>

  (e : Fin (k + 1) → X), Fin.init (Fin.append x e) = Fin.append x (Fin.init e)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Head.init_append_succ.{u_1} : ∀ {X : Type u_1} {n k : ℕ} (x : Fin n → X)
  (e : Fin (k + 1) → X), Fin.init (Fin.append x e) = Fin.append x (Fin.init e) :=
fun {X} {n k} x e =>
  funext fun i =>
    Fin.addCases
      (fun l =>
        id
          (have h1 := Fin.ext rfl;
          Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => Fin.append x e _a = Fin.append x (Fin.init e) (Fin.castAdd k l)) h1))
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = Fin.append x (Fin.init e) (Fin.castAdd k l)) (Fin.append_left x e l)))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => x l = _a) (Fin.append_left x (Fin.init e) l))) (Eq.refl (x l))))))
      (fun l =>
        id
          (have h1 := Fin.ext rfl;
          Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => Fin.append x e _a = Fin.append x (Fin.init e) (Fin.natAdd n l)) h1))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a => _a = Fin.append x (Fin.init e) (Fin.natAdd n l))
                  (Fin.append_right x e l.castSucc)))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => e l.castSucc = _a) (Fin.append_right x (Fin.init e) l)))
                (Eq.refl (e l.castSucc))))))
      i

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Head.unbundle_pullback : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {S : Set M} {r k : ℕ}
  {Y : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 r) S}
  {lab : Fin k → Fin r},

    DiamondIntegral.Section2.IsRVPullback Y.carrier :=

    {r k} {Y} {lab} hB =>
  Set.Subset.antisymm
    (fun ⦃q⦄ hq =>
      Exists.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section2.mem_rvHull_iff Y.carrier q).mp hq) fun p h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hp right =>
          And.casesOn right fun h1 h2 =>
            Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Head.lift_mem hp) fun e he =>
              have hQ :=
                Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (Fin.append q.1 e, q.2) ∈ _a) (Eq.symm hB)))
                  ((DiamondIntegral.Section2.mem_rvHull_iff (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvHeadStartBundle Y k lab).carrier
                        (Fin.append q.1 e, q.2)).mpr
                    (Exists.intro (Fin.append p.1 e, p.2)
                      ⟨he,
                        ⟨id
                            (have hpq := h1;
                            funext fun i =>
                              Fin.addCases
                                (fun l =>
                                  Eq.mpr
                                    (id
                                      (congr
                                        (congrArg Eq
                                          (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv.congr_simp M (Fin.append p.1 e (Fin.castAdd k l))
                                            (p.1 l) (Fin.append_left p.1 e l)))
                                        (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv.congr_simp M (Fin.append q.1 e (Fin.castAdd k l))
                                          (q.1 l) (Fin.append_left q.1 e l))))
                                    (congrFun hpq l))
                                (fun l =>
                                  of_eq_true
                                    (Eq.trans
                                      (congr
                                        (congrArg Eq
                                          (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv.congr_simp M (Fin.append p.1 e (Fin.natAdd 1 l))
                                            (e l) (Fin.append_right p.1 e l)))
                                        (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv.congr_simp M (Fin.append q.1 e (Fin.natAdd 1 l))
                                          (e l) (Fin.append_right q.1 e l)))
                                      (eq_self (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (e l)))))
                                i),
                          h2⟩⟩));
              have this := ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.mem_rvHeadStartBundle Y k lab (Fin.append q.1 e) q.2).mp hQ).left;
              Eq.mp
                (congrArg (fun _a => (_a, q.2) ∈ Y.carrier)
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Head.headStartBaseVF_append k q.1 e))
                this)

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Prod.append_inj' : ∀ {M : Type} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  {a b : ℕ} {x x' : Fin a → M} {z z' : Fin b → M}, Fin.append x z = Fin.append x' z' ↔ x = x' ∧ z = z'
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Prod.append_inj' : ∀ {M : Type}
  [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] {a b : ℕ} {x x' : Fin a → M} {z z' : Fin b → M},
  Fin.append x z = Fin.append x' z' ↔ x = x' ∧ z = z' :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] {a b} {x x'} {z z'} =>
  {
    mp := fun h =>
      ⟨funext fun i =>
          Eq.mp (congr (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_left x z i)) (Fin.append_left x' z' i)) (congrFun h (Fin.castAdd b i)),
        funext fun i =>
          Eq.mp (congr (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_right x z i)) (Fin.append_right x' z' i))
            (congrFun h (Fin.natAdd a i))⟩,
    mpr := fun a_1 => And.casesOn a_1 fun left right => left ▸ right ▸ Eq.refl (Fin.append x z) }

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.DatumSchema.existsUnique_fin_one : ∀ {M : Type}
  [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] (P : (Fin 1 → M) → Prop), (∃! b, P b) ↔ ∃! t, P fun x => t
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.DatumSchema.existsUnique_fin_one : ∀ {M : Type}
  [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] (P : (Fin 1 → M) → Prop), (∃! b, P b) ↔ ∃! t, P fun x => t :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] P =>
  have e := fun b =>
    funext fun j =>
      List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x => List.finRange 1 = a → Fintype.complete j ≍ x → b j = b 0)
        (Fintype.complete j)
        (fun as h =>
          List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun j => ∀ (this : j ∈ Fintype.elems), [] ≍ as → this ≍ List.Mem.head as → b j = b 0)
              (fun this tail_eq =>
                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun as => this ≍ List.Mem.head as → b ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩) = b 0)
                  (fun h => Eq.refl (b ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩))) (eq_of_heq tail_eq))
              (eq_of_heq head_eq) (Fintype.complete j))
        (fun b_1 {as} a h =>
          List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b_2 => [] ≍ as → Fintype.complete j ≍ List.Mem.tail b_2 a → b j = b 0)
              (fun tail_eq =>
                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {as} =>
                  ∀ (a : List.Mem j as),
                    Fintype.complete j ≍ List.Mem.tail ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl 1⟩) a → b j = b 0)
                  (fun a h =>
                    List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a_1 x => [] = a_1 → a ≍ x → b j = b 0) a
                      (fun as h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h))
                      (fun b_2 {as} a_1 h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h)) (Eq.refl []) (HEq.refl a))
                  (eq_of_heq tail_eq) a)
              (eq_of_heq head_eq))
        (Eq.refl (List.finRange 1)) (HEq.refl (Fintype.complete j));
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun b h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hb hu =>
          Exists.intro (b 0)
            ⟨id (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => P _a) (Eq.symm (e b)))) hb), fun t ht =>
              have this := hu (fun x => t) ht;
              Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => t = _a 0) (Eq.symm this))) (Eq.refl t)⟩,
    mpr := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun t h =>
        And.casesOn h fun ht hu =>
          Exists.intro (fun x => t)
            ⟨ht, fun b hb =>
              Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = fun x => t) (e b)))
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => (fun x => _a) = fun x => t)
                      (hu (b 0) (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => (fun b => P b) _a) (e b)) hb))))
                  (Eq.refl fun x => t))⟩ }

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.exists_isoSchema : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {B : SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.Base} {p : ℕ}
  {sp : Fin p → SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag} {C : SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.Base}
  {d : ℕ} {z : Fin p → M},
  (∀ (i : Fin p), SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.sortEval (sp i) (z i)) →
    DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.Promotable B C z →
      ∀ {X Y : DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.ChartSchema B sp d},
        X.Valid z →
          Y.Valid z →
            ∀ (F : (Fin X.arity → M) → Fin Y.arity → M),
              SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase C
                  (Fin.append (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.rvs X.arity)
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.rvs Y.arity))
                  {w |
                    (fun i => w (Fin.castAdd Y.arity i)) ∈ X.row z ∧
                      (F fun i => w (Fin.castAdd Y.arity i)) = fun j => w (Fin.natAdd X.arity j)} →
                Set.BijOn F (X.row z) (Y.row z) →
                  (∀ u ∈ X.row z, X.weightAt z u = Y.weightAt z (F u)) → ∃ Φ, Φ.Valid z :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {B} {p}
    {sp} {C} {d} {z} hz hC {X Y} hX hY F hF hbij hw =>
  Exists.casesOn
    (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.promoteSet2 hz (fun {n} => hC)
      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.rvs X.arity) (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.rvs Y.arity)
      {w |
        (fun i => w (Fin.castAdd Y.arity i)) ∈ X.row z ∧
          (F fun i => w (Fin.castAdd Y.arity i)) = fun j => w (Fin.natAdd X.arity j)}
      hF)
    fun P h =>
    And.casesOn h fun hP hPS =>
      have hrow := fun u v =>
        Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ↔ u ∈ X.row z ∧ F u = v) (propext (hPS u v))))
          (of_eq_true
            (Eq.trans
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg Iff
                  (Eq.trans Set.mem_setOf_eq
                    (congr (congrArg And (congrArg (Membership.mem (X.row z)) (funext fun i => Fin.append_left u v i)))
                      (congr (congrArg Eq (congrArg F (funext fun i => Fin.append_left u v i)))
                        (funext fun j => Fin.append_right u v j)))))
                (u ∈ X.row z ∧ F u = v))
              (iff_self ((fun i => u i) ∈ X.row z ∧ (F fun i => u i) = fun j => v j))));
      Exists.intro { graph := P, graph_definable := hP }
        {
          bij :=
            ⟨⟨hz,
                ⟨fun u hu =>
                  Exists.intro (F u) ⟨(hrow u (F u)).mpr ⟨hu, rfl⟩, fun v h => Eq.symm ((hrow u v).mp h).right⟩,
                  ⟨fun u v h => ((hrow u v).mp h).left, fun v hv =>
                    have hsub := fun x hx => (hrow x v).mp hx;
                    have hss := fun ⦃x⦄ x_1 =>
                      And.casesOn (motive := fun x_2 =>
                        ∀ ⦃y : Fin X.arity → M⦄, y ∈ {x | x ∈ X.row z ∧ F x = v} → x = y) x_1 fun hx right =>
                        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun v =>
                          (∀ (j : Fin Y.arity),
                              SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.sortEval
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.rvs Y.arity j) (v j)) →
                            {x | Fin.append (Fin.append z x) v ∈ P} ⊆ {x | x ∈ X.row z ∧ F x = v} →
                              ∀ ⦃y : Fin X.arity → M⦄, y ∈ {x | x ∈ X.row z ∧ F x = v} → x = y)
                          (fun hv hsub ⦃x'⦄ x_2 =>
                            And.casesOn x_2 fun hx' he => Set.BijOn.injOn hbij hx hx' (Eq.symm he))
                          right hv hsub;
                    ⟨Set.Finite.subset (Set.Subsingleton.finite hss) hsub,
                      LE.le.trans (Set.ncard_le_ncard hsub (Set.Subsingleton.finite hss))
                        ((Set.ncard_le_one (Set.Subsingleton.finite hss)).mpr fun a ha b hb => hss ha hb)⟩⟩⟩⟩,
              fun v =>
              {
                mp := fun hv =>
                  Exists.casesOn (Set.BijOn.surjOn hbij hv) fun u h =>
                    And.casesOn h fun hu right =>
                      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun v =>
                        Fin.append z v ∈ Y.domain →
                          ∃ x, Fin.append (Fin.append z x) v ∈ { graph := P, graph_definable := hP }.graph)
                        (fun hv => Exists.intro u ((hrow u (F u)).mpr ⟨hu, rfl⟩)) right hv,
                mpr := fun a =>
                  Exists.casesOn a fun u h =>
                    And.casesOn ((hrow u v).mp h) fun hu right =>
                      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun v =>
                        Fin.append (Fin.append z u) v ∈ { graph := P, graph_definable := hP }.graph →
                          Fin.append z v ∈ Y.domain)
                        (fun h => Set.BijOn.mapsTo hbij hu) right h }⟩,
          weight := fun u v y y' c c' h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 a a_1 a_2 a_3 =>
            And.casesOn ((hrow u v).mp h1) fun hu right =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun v =>
                { graph := P, graph_definable := hP }.graphRow z u v →

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

  (D : DiamondIntegral.Section4.RelativeAnnularGenerators.AnnularDatum C k),
  SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase C
    (Fin.append (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.rvs D.chart.arity)
      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.rvs 1))

fun {M} [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
    [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {C} {k} D =>
  have h :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.append_graph_definable D.chart.domain (fun u => ![D.aperture.aperture u])
      (fun u hu i =>
        SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase.proper D.chart.domain_definable u hu i)
      (fun u hu i =>
        List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x =>
          List.finRange (Nat.succ 0) = a →
            Fintype.complete i ≍ x →
              SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.sortEval SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv
                (![D.aperture.aperture u] i))
          (Fintype.complete i)
          (fun as h =>
            List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun i =>
                ∀ (this : i ∈ Fintype.elems),
                  [] ≍ as →
                    this ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                      SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.sortEval SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv
                        (![D.aperture.aperture u] i))
                (fun this tail_eq =>
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun as =>
                    this ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                      SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.sortEval SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv
                        (![D.aperture.aperture u] ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl (Nat.succ 0)⟩)))
                    (fun h => (D.aperture.nonzero u hu).left) (eq_of_heq tail_eq))
                (eq_of_heq head_eq) (Fintype.complete i))
          (fun b {as} a h =>
            List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b =>
                [] ≍ as →
                  Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail b a →
                    SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.sortEval SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv
                      (![D.aperture.aperture u] i))

                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {as} =>
                    ∀ (a : List.Mem i as),
                      Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl (Nat.succ 0)⟩) a →
                        SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.sortEval SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv
                          (![D.aperture.aperture u] i))

                        [] = a_1 →

                              (![D.aperture.aperture u] i))

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Reduce.properInvariant_of_transl : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

  {X Y : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace m q) S}
  (f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map X Y),
  Function.Bijective f.toFun →
    (∀ (p : ↑X.carrier), (↑(f.toFun p)).2 = (↑p).2) →
      (∀ (p p' : ↑X.carrier),
          (↑p).2 = (↑p').2 →
            DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Reduce.trAt f p = DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Reduce.trAt f p') →
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S Y.carrier →
          DiamondIntegral.Section6.VFBounded X.carrier → DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S X.carrier
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Reduce.properInvariant_of_transl : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {S : Set M} {m q : ℕ}
  {X Y : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace m q) S}
  (f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map X Y),
  Function.Bijective f.toFun →
    (∀ (p : ↑X.carrier), (↑(f.toFun p)).2 = (↑p).2) →
      (∀ (p p' : ↑X.carrier),
          (↑p).2 = (↑p').2 →
            DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Reduce.trAt f p = DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Reduce.trAt f p') →
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S Y.carrier →
          DiamondIntegral.Section6.VFBounded X.carrier → DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S X.carrier :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {m q} {X Y} f hf hlab htr hY hXb =>
  { definable := X.definable, vfBounded := hXb,
    rvBounded :=
      Exists.casesOn hY.rvBounded fun γ hγ =>
        Exists.intro γ fun p hp i =>
          have this := hγ (↑(f.toFun ⟨p, hp⟩)) (f.toFun ⟨p, hp⟩).property i;
          Eq.mp
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                ↑γ⁻¹ ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (_a i) ∧
                  SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv (_a i) ≤ ↑γ)
              (hlab ⟨p, hp⟩))
            this,
    radii := fun t =>
      Exists.casesOn (hY.radii t) fun α h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hα hinv =>
          Exists.intro α
            ⟨hα,
              if hne : ∃ p, (↑p).2 = t then
                Exists.casesOn hne fun p₀ hp₀ =>
                  have he :=
                    Set.ext fun a =>
                      {
                        mp := fun ha =>
                          id
                            (fun ha =>
                              have hv :=
                                DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Reduce.transl_value f hlab htr p₀ a
                                  (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (a, _a) ∈ X.carrier) hp₀)) ha);
                              have hmem :=
                                (f.toFun
                                    ⟨(a, (↑p₀).2),
                                      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (a, _a) ∈ X.carrier) hp₀)) ha⟩).property;
                              Eq.mp
                                (congrArg
                                  (fun _a => (a + DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Reduce.trAt f p₀, _a) ∈ Y.carrier)
                                  hp₀)
                                (Eq.mp
                                  (congrArg
                                    (fun _a => (a + DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Reduce.trAt f p₀, _a) ∈ Y.carrier)
                                    (hlab p₀))
                                  (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ Y.carrier) hv) hmem)))
                            ha,
                        mpr := fun ha =>
                          id
                            (fun ha =>
                              Exists.casesOn (hf.right ⟨(a + DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Reduce.trAt f p₀, t), ha⟩)
                                fun p hp =>
                                have hpt :=
                                  have this := congrArg (fun z => (↑z).2) hp;
                                  Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a = t) (hlab p)) this;
                                have hv :=
                                  DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Reduce.transl_value f hlab htr p₀ (↑p).1
                                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ((↑p).1, _a) ∈ X.carrier) hp₀))
                                      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ((↑p).1, _a) ∈ X.carrier) (Eq.symm hpt)))
                                        p.property));
                                have hpe := Subtype.ext (Prod.ext rfl (Eq.trans hp₀ (Eq.symm hpt)));
                                have h1 :=
                                  congrArg Prod.fst
                                    (Eq.mp
                                      (congrArg
                                        (fun _a =>
                                          ↑_a =
                                            ((↑p).1 + DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Reduce.trAt f p₀,
                                              (↑(f.toFun p₀)).2))
                                        hp)
                                      (Eq.mp
                                        (congrArg
                                          (fun _a =>
                                            ↑(f.toFun _a) =
                                              ((↑p).1 + DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Reduce.trAt f p₀,
                                                (↑(f.toFun p₀)).2))
                                          hpe)
                                        hv));
                                have hap := add_right_cancel h1;
                                id
                                  (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (_a, t) ∈ X.carrier) hap))
                                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ((↑p).1, _a) ∈ X.carrier) (Eq.symm hpt)))
                                      p.property)))
                            ha };
                  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section6.AlphaInvariant α _a) he))
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Reduce.alphaInvariant_translate hinv
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Reduce.trAt f p₀))
              else
                have he := Set.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun a ha => hne (Exists.intro ⟨(a, t), ha⟩ rfl);
                Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section6.AlphaInvariant α _a) he)) fun a b a_1 =>
                  Iff.rfl⟩ }

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.ChartSchema.volRow_iff_mem : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {B : SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.Base} {p : ℕ}
  {sp : Fin p → SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag} {d : ℕ}
  (W : DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Schema.ChartSchema B sp d) (z : Fin p → M) (u : Fin W.arity → M)
  (y : Fin 1 → M), W.volRow z u (y 0) ↔ Fin.append (Fin.append z u) y ∈ W.volume :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {B} {p}
    {sp} {d} W z u y =>
  id
    (have this :=
      funext fun j =>
        List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x => List.finRange 1 = a → Fintype.complete j ≍ x → y 0 = y j)
          (Fintype.complete j)
          (fun as h =>
            List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun j => ∀ (this : j ∈ Fintype.elems), [] ≍ as → this ≍ List.Mem.head as → y 0 = y j)

                    (fun h => Eq.refl (y 0)) (eq_of_heq tail_eq))
                (eq_of_heq head_eq) (Fintype.complete j))
          (fun b {as} a h =>
            List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b => [] ≍ as → Fintype.complete j ≍ List.Mem.tail b a → y 0 = y j)

                    (fun a h =>

                (eq_of_heq head_eq))

      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => Fin.append (Fin.append z u) _a ∈ W.volume ↔ Fin.append (Fin.append z u) y ∈ W.volume)

          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (_a, q.2) ∈ C ↔ (fun x => F.centers D, q.2) ∈ C) hu)) Iff.rfl))
  else
    have hf :=
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => _a = q.1 0)
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.vfFamilyFreeze_eq F.balls F.centers F.separated (q.1 0))))
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.FMT.familyFreeze_outside
          (fun D => {y | ↑y ∈ SpecialTransformations.Section3.OpenBallCodes.underlying ↑D}) F.centers (q.1 0)

        Eq.symm hi ▸ Eq.refl (q.1 0);
    Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => q ∈ C ↔ (fun x => _a, q.2) ∈ C) hf))
      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => q ∈ C ↔ (_a, q.2) ∈ C) hu)) Iff.rfl)

    (Prod.mk.inj
      (Eq.mp
        (congrArg

            (Fin.snoc (Fin.init (↑p).1) ((↑(D.st.lift.toFun (D.prep.toFun p))).1 (Fin.last (m + 1))),

        (congr
          (congrArg Eq (Fin.init_snoc ((↑(D.st.lift.toFun (D.prep.toFun p))).1 (Fin.last (m + 1))) (Fin.init (↑p).1)))

        (congr

                                  (Fin.init (↑p').1 + Fin.init (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma714Reduce.trAt D.prep p'))

      {γ : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M},

          SpecialTransformations.Section3.BallImaginaries.underlying (DiamondIntegral.Section2.openDiscCode d γ) →
        ∀ {x x' : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M}, x ∈ D → x' ∈ D → ↑γ < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (x - x') :=

  [sM : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

  CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical →
    ∀ {n r k s : ℕ} (A : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M n r))
      (f : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M n r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M k s)

      S.Definable SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV R →
        (∀ (x : (Fin n → SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType) × (Fin r → CanonicalRV.RVSort M))

    hc {n r k s} A f R hR hRiff =>
  id
    (have hdom₁ :=
      Set.Definable.mono (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).domain_definable (Set.empty_subset S);
    have hdom₂ :=
      Set.Definable.mono (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace k s).domain_definable (Set.empty_subset S);
    let X :=
      {w |
        w ∘ Sum.inr ∈ (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r).domain ∧
          Sum.elim (w ∘ Sum.inr) (w ∘ Sum.inl) ∈ R};

      Set.Definable.inter (Set.Definable.preimage_comp Sum.inr hdom₁)

      DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.definable_of_overBase hc
        (IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.FullBaseAtomicity.OverBase.exists_block
          (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.overBase_of_definable hc hX));

      (eq_of_heq
        ((fun M A L inst α s s' e'_6 =>
            Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a x => s' = a → e'_6 ≍ x → A.Definable L s ≍ A.Definable L s') e'_6
              (fun h =>
                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun s' => ∀ (e_6 : s = s'), e_6 ≍ Eq.refl s → A.Definable L s ≍ A.Definable L s')

              (Eq.refl s') (HEq.refl e'_6))
          M S SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV sM (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace k s).Index
          ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace k s).preimage (f '' A))
          ((SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace k s).domain ∩ {z | ∃ b, Sum.elim z b ∈ X})
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  _a = (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace k s).domain ∩ {z | ∃ b, Sum.elim z b ∈ X})
                (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.preimage_eq_image (f '' A))))
            (Set.ext fun c =>
              {
                mp := fun a =>
                  Exists.casesOn a fun y h =>
                    And.casesOn h fun left right =>
                      Exists.casesOn left fun x h =>
                        And.casesOn h fun hx right_1 =>
                          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun y =>
                            SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues y = c →
                              c ∈
                                (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace k s).domain ∩
                                  {z | ∃ b, Sum.elim z b ∈ X})

                              right ▸
