theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.Build.mem_cellAt_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {r : ℕ} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G]
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 2 r) S}
  (X : DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.Build A) (h00 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF00)
  (hc : CanonicalStructure.IsCanonical) (linear : DiamondIntegral.Section2.GammaPiecewiseRationalAffineInput)
  {κ : Cardinal.{0}} (hκ : Cardinal.aleph0 < κ) (hs : SpecialTransformations.Section3.Saturated M κ)
  (hv :
    ∀ (x y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
      SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.VFValued.predV x y ↔ Valued.v x ≤ Valued.v y)
  (hsmall : Cardinal.mk ↑S < κ) (hΓ : DiamondIntegral.Section2.NontrivialDefinableGamma { real := S, gamma := ∅ })
  (s : ↑X.S₂.stage.contracted.carrier) (x y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
  (x, y) ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCellInput.cellAt (X.contraction h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall hΓ) s ↔
    ∃ b,
      X.S₂.stage.contraction.toFun b = s ∧
        (↑b).1 0 = x ∧ DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (y - X.eps₁ b) = (↑b).2 X.S₁.stage.leading :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} {r}
    {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} X h00 hc linear {κ} hκ hs hv
    hsmall hΓ s x y =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun p h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hp hq =>
          let a :=
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfRelabeling X.N.map.image (Equiv.refl (Fin 2))).toFun (X.N.bijection.toFun p);
          have ha := rfl;
          Exists.intro (X.S₁.stage.contraction.toFun a)
            ⟨hp,
              ⟨have h1 :=
                  congrFun (DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage.contraction_fixes_complement X.S₁.stage a)
                    0;
                have hx := (Prod.mk.inj hq).left;
                Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = x) h1))
                  (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => Fin.init (↑a).1 0 = _a) hx)) (Eq.refl (Fin.init (↑a).1 0))),
                have h :=
                  ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.Stage.contraction_eq_iff X.S₁.stage X.S₁.displacement a
                            (X.S₁.stage.contraction.toFun a)).mp
                        rfl).right.right;
                have hy := (Prod.mk.inj hq).right;
                Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg
                      (fun _a =>
                        DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (_a - X.eps₁ (X.S₁.stage.contraction.toFun a)) =
                          (↑(X.S₁.stage.contraction.toFun a)).2 X.S₁.stage.leading)
                      hy))
                  h⟩⟩,
    mpr := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun b h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hb right =>
          And.casesOn right fun hx hy =>
            Exists.casesOn
              (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.Stage.exists_mem_fibre X.S₁.stage X.S₁.displacement b y hy) fun a h =>
              And.casesOn h fun ha hay =>
                Exists.casesOn
                  (Function.Bijective.surjective
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfRelabeling_bijective X.N.map.image (Equiv.refl (Fin 2))) a)
                  fun c hc' =>
                  Exists.casesOn
                    (Function.Bijective.surjective (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ZeroCenteredData.bijective X.N h00) c)
                    fun p hp =>
                    Exists.intro p
                      ⟨Eq.mpr
                          (id
                            (congrArg (fun _a => _a = s)
                              (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.Build.contraction_apply X h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall
                                hΓ p)))
                          (Eq.mpr
                            (id
                              (congrArg
                                (fun _a =>
                                  X.S₂.stage.contraction.toFun
                                      (X.S₁.stage.contraction.toFun
                                        ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfRelabeling X.N.map.image
                                              (Equiv.refl (Fin 2))).toFun
                                          _a)) =
                                    s)
                                hp))
                            (Eq.mpr
                              (id
                                (congrArg (fun _a => X.S₂.stage.contraction.toFun (X.S₁.stage.contraction.toFun _a) = s)
                                  hc'))
                              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => X.S₂.stage.contraction.toFun _a = s) ha))
                                (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = s) hb)) (Eq.refl s))))),
                        have hav :=
                          Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑_a = X.N.point ↑p) (Eq.symm hc')))
                            (Eq.mpr
                              (id
                                (congrArg
                                  (fun _a =>
                                    ↑((DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfRelabeling X.N.map.image (Equiv.refl (Fin 2))).toFun
                                          _a) =
                                      X.N.point ↑p)
                                  (Eq.symm hp)))
                              (Eq.refl
                                ↑((DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfRelabeling X.N.map.image (Equiv.refl (Fin 2))).toFun
                                    (X.N.bijection.toFun p))));
                        have hax :=
                          Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (↑a).1 0 = _a) (Eq.symm hx)))
                            (Eq.trans
                              (Eq.symm
                                (congrFun
                                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage.contraction_fixes_complement
                                    X.S₁.stage a)
                                  0))
                              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (↑_a).1 0 = (↑b).1 0) ha)) (Eq.refl ((↑b).1 0))));
                        Prod.ext
                          (id
                            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => x = _a.1 0) (Eq.symm hav)))
                              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => x = _a) hax)) (Eq.refl x))))
                          (id (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => y = _a.1 1) (Eq.symm hav))) (Eq.symm hay)))⟩ }

                            y₂ = DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.rawFun B ε (c ∘ Sum.inr) z →

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.mem_rawGraph_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [sM : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {S : Set M} {a : ℕ}
  (B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 a) S)
  (f :
    SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map B
      (SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.univ (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawVFSpace 1) S))
  (z : (Fin 1 ⊕ Fin a) ⊕ Fin 1 → M),
  z ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.rawGraph B f ↔
    ∃ q,
      Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues ↑q)
          (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues ↑(f.toFun q)) =
        z :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} {a}
    B f z =>
  {
    mp := fun a_1 =>
      Exists.casesOn a_1 fun hx h =>
        Exists.casesOn h fun hy h =>
          Exists.casesOn h fun q h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hq hfq =>
              have he₁ :=
                Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues _a = z ∘ Sum.inl) hq))
                  (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inl, hx⟩);
              have he₂ :=
                Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues _a = z ∘ Sum.inr) hfq))
                  (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues_decode ⟨z ∘ Sum.inr, hy⟩);
              Exists.intro q
                (funext fun i =>
                  Sum.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
                    i = t →
                      Sum.elim (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues ↑q)
                          (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues ↑(f.toFun q)) i =
                        z i)
                    i (fun i_1 h => Eq.symm h ▸ congrFun he₁ i_1) (fun i_1 h => Eq.symm h ▸ congrFun he₂ i_1)
                    (Eq.refl i)),
    mpr := fun a_1 =>
      Exists.casesOn a_1 fun q h =>
        h ▸
          Exists.intro (SpecialTransformations.Section4.mixedValues_mem_domain ↑q)
            (Exists.intro (Exists.intro (↑(f.toFun q)) rfl)
              (Exists.intro q
                ⟨Eq.symm (SpecialTransformations.Section4.decode_mixedValues ↑q),
                  Eq.symm (SpecialTransformations.Section4.decode_vfValues ↑(f.toFun q))⟩)) }

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.slopeAt_iff_row : ∀ {M : Type}
  [sM : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

    SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue b = β →

            DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.slopeRow A f (Sum.elim p ![↑x, b, ↑t])
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.slopeAt_iff_row : ∀ {M : Type}
  [sM : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {n : ℕ} (A : (Fin n → M) → Set M) (f : (Fin n → M) → M → M)
  (hfVF : ∀ (p : Fin n → M), ∀ x ∈ A p, SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iVF (f p x)) (p : Fin n → M) (A' : Set M)
  (hA' : A' ⊆ A p) (x : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) (β : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Gamma M) (b : M),
  SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.NonzeroRV b →
    SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue b = β →
      ∀ (t : CanonicalRV.RVSort M),
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.RVLinearRadiusClosure.SlopeAt A' (f p) ⋯ x β t ↔
          IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.GammaRadiusAtomicity.gammaBall x β true ⊆ A' ∧
            DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.slopeRow A f (Sum.elim p ![↑x, b, ↑t]) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n} A f
    hfVF p A' hA' x β b hb hbβ t =>
  have hball := fun y =>
    {
      mp := fun h =>
        have this := (IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.UniformGammaBallSyntax.ball_iff b hb ⟨y, h.left⟩ x).mp h;
        Eq.mp
          (congrArg (fun _a => ↑⟨y, h.left⟩ ∈ IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.GammaRadiusAtomicity.gammaBall x _a true)
            hbβ)
          this,
      mpr := fun h =>
        (IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.UniformGammaBallSyntax.ball_iff b hb ⟨y, h.1⟩ x).mpr
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => ↑⟨y, h.1⟩ ∈ IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.GammaRadiusAtomicity.gammaBall x _a true)
                hbβ))
            h) };
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      And.casesOn a fun ht right =>
        Exists.casesOn right fun hSub hLin =>
          ⟨hSub,
            ⟨hb,
              ⟨⟨t.property, ht⟩, fun y y' hy hy' =>
                Exists.casesOn (Exists.intro ⟨y, hy.left⟩ rfl) fun yv h =>
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun y =>
                    IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.UniformGammaBallSyntax.ball (Sum.elim p ![↑x, b, ↑t] (Sum.inr 1)) y
                        (Sum.elim p ![↑x, b, ↑t] (Sum.inr 0)) →
                      y ∈ A (Sum.elim p ![↑x, b, ↑t] ∘ Sum.inl) ∧
                        y' ∈ A (Sum.elim p ![↑x, b, ↑t] ∘ Sum.inl) ∧
                          IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.RVDifferencePairs.difference
                              (f (Sum.elim p ![↑x, b, ↑t] ∘ Sum.inl) y') (f (Sum.elim p ![↑x, b, ↑t] ∘ Sum.inl) y) =
                            IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.RVSlopeGraph.multiply (Sum.elim p ![↑x, b, ↑t] (Sum.inr 2))
                              (IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.RVDifferencePairs.difference y' y))
                    (fun hy =>
                      Exists.casesOn (Exists.intro ⟨y', hy'.left⟩ rfl) fun yv' h =>
                        Eq.ndrec (motive := fun y' =>
                          IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.UniformGammaBallSyntax.ball
                              (Sum.elim p ![↑x, b, ↑t] (Sum.inr 1)) y' (Sum.elim p ![↑x, b, ↑t] (Sum.inr 0)) →
                            ↑yv ∈ A (Sum.elim p ![↑x, b, ↑t] ∘ Sum.inl) ∧
                              y' ∈ A (Sum.elim p ![↑x, b, ↑t] ∘ Sum.inl) ∧
                                IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.RVDifferencePairs.difference
                                    (f (Sum.elim p ![↑x, b, ↑t] ∘ Sum.inl) y')
                                    (f (Sum.elim p ![↑x, b, ↑t] ∘ Sum.inl) ↑yv) =
                                  IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.RVSlopeGraph.multiply
                                    (Sum.elim p ![↑x, b, ↑t] (Sum.inr 2))
                                    (IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.RVDifferencePairs.difference y' ↑yv))
                          (fun hy' =>
                            have hyB := (hball ↑yv).mp hy;
                            have hy'B := (hball ↑yv').mp hy';
                            ⟨hA' (hSub hyB),
                              ⟨hA' (hSub hy'B),
                                have hL := hLin yv yv' hyB hy'B;
                                let fy := ⟨f p ↑yv, hfVF p (↑yv) (hA' (hSub hyB))⟩;
                                let fy' := ⟨f p ↑yv', hfVF p (↑yv') (hA' (hSub hy'B))⟩;
                                have h1 := IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.RVDifferencePairs.difference_vf fy' fy;
                                have h2 := IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.RVDifferencePairs.difference_vf yv' yv;
                                id
                                  (Eq.mpr
                                    (id
                                      (congrArg
                                        (fun _a =>
                                          _a =
                                            IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.RVSlopeGraph.multiply (↑t)
                                              (IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.RVDifferencePairs.difference ↑yv' ↑yv))
                                        h1))
                                    (Eq.mpr
                                      (id
                                        (congrArg
                                          (fun _a =>
                                            SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRv ↑(fy' - fy) =
                                              IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.RVSlopeGraph.multiply (↑t) _a)
                                          h2))
                                      (Eq.trans hL
                                        (Eq.symm
                                          (IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.RVSlopeGraph.multiply_rv t
                                            (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (yv' - yv)))))))⟩⟩)
                          h hy')
                    h hy⟩⟩⟩,
    mpr := fun a =>
      And.casesOn a fun hSub right =>
        And.casesOn right fun left right =>
          And.casesOn right fun ht hrow =>
            ⟨ht.right,
              Exists.intro hSub fun y y' hy hy' =>
                And.casesOn (hrow (↑y) (↑y') ((hball ↑y).mpr hy) ((hball ↑y').mpr hy')) fun left right =>
                  And.casesOn right fun left heq =>
                    id
                      (fun heq =>
                        have h1 :=
                          IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.RVDifferencePairs.difference_vf
                            ⟨f p ↑y', hfVF p (↑y') (hA' (hSub hy'))⟩ ⟨f p ↑y, hfVF p (↑y) (hA' (hSub hy))⟩;
                        have h2 := IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.RVDifferencePairs.difference_vf y' y;
                        id
                          (fun h1 =>
                            Eq.trans
                              (Eq.mp
                                (congrArg
                                  (fun _a =>
                                    SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRv
                                        ↑(⟨f p ↑y', hfVF p (↑y') (hA' (hSub hy'))⟩ -
                                            ⟨f p ↑y, hfVF p (↑y) (hA' (hSub hy))⟩) =
                                      IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.RVSlopeGraph.multiply (↑t) _a)
                                  h2)
                                (Eq.mp
                                  (congrArg
                                    (fun _a =>
                                      _a =
                                        IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.RVSlopeGraph.multiply (↑t)
                                          (IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.RVDifferencePairs.difference ↑y' ↑y))
                                    h1)
                                  heq))
                              (IntegrationInACVF.Section3ACVF.RVSlopeGraph.multiply_rv t
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (y' - y))))
                          h1)
                      heq⟩ }

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.Stage.diffMap_compat : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n r : ℕ} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G]
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + 1) r) S}
  (T : DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage A),
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.SameLabelShearDisplacement T.lift (Fin.last n) →
    ∀ (p q : ↑A.carrier),
      T.contraction.toFun p = T.contraction.toFun q →
        (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.Stage.diffMap T).toFun p =
          (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.Stage.diffMap T).toFun q :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n r} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} T hD p q he =>
  have hval :=
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (Fin.init (↑(T.lift.toFun q)).1, (↑(T.lift.toFun q)).2))
          (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage.contraction_value T p))))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => ↑(T.contraction.toFun p) = _a)
            (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage.contraction_value T q))))
        (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑_a = ↑(T.contraction.toFun q)) he)) (Eq.refl ↑(T.contraction.toFun q))));
  have hInit := (Prod.mk.inj hval).left;
  have hOut := (Prod.mk.inj hval).right;
  have hIn :=
    funext fun i =>
      Eq.mpr
        (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (↑q).2 i) (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.Stage.labels_of_contraction T p i)))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a => (↑(T.contraction.toFun p)).2 (T.oldLabels i) = _a)
              (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.Stage.labels_of_contraction T q i)))
          (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (↑_a).2 (T.oldLabels i) = (↑(T.contraction.toFun q)).2 (T.oldLabels i)) he))
            (Eq.refl ((↑(T.contraction.toFun q)).2 (T.oldLabels i)))));
  have hOther := fun i hi =>
    Exists.casesOn (Fin.exists_castSucc_eq.mpr hi) fun j h =>
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun i => i ≠ Fin.last n → (↑p).1 i = (↑q).1 i)
        (fun hi =>
          Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (↑q).1 j.castSucc) (Eq.symm (T.relative p j))))
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (↑(T.lift.toFun p)).1 j.castSucc = _a) (Eq.symm (T.relative q j))))
              (congrFun hInit j)))
        h hi;
  have h := hD p q hIn hOut hOther;
  Subtype.ext
    (funext fun k =>
      have hk := Subsingleton.elim k 0;
      Eq.symm hk ▸
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ↑((DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.Stage.diffMap T).toFun q) 0)
              (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.Stage.diffMap_value T p)))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => (↑p).1 (Fin.last n) - (↑(T.lift.toFun p)).1 (Fin.last n) = _a)
                (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.Stage.diffMap_value T q)))
            (have h' :=
              Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => -_a = -((↑(T.lift.toFun q)).1 (Fin.last n) - (↑q).1 (Fin.last n))) h))
                (Eq.refl (-((↑(T.lift.toFun q)).1 (Fin.last n) - (↑q).1 (Fin.last n))));
            Eq.mp
              (congr (congrArg Eq (neg_sub ((↑(T.lift.toFun p)).1 (Fin.last n)) ((↑p).1 (Fin.last n))))
                (neg_sub ((↑(T.lift.toFun q)).1 (Fin.last n)) ((↑q).1 (Fin.last n))))
              h')))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.Stage.contraction_eq_iff : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n r : ℕ} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G]
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + 1) r) S}
  (T : DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage A)
  (hD : DiamondIntegral.Section6.SameLabelShearDisplacement T.lift (Fin.last n)) (p : ↑A.carrier)
  (b : ↑T.contracted.carrier),
  T.contraction.toFun p = b ↔
    Fin.init (↑p).1 = (↑b).1 ∧
      (∀ (i : Fin r), (↑p).2 i = (↑b).2 (T.oldLabels i)) ∧
        DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M ((↑p).1 (Fin.last n) - DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.Stage.eps T hD b) =
          (↑b).2 T.leading :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n r} {G} [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {A} T hD p b =>
  {

      a ▸
        ⟨Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage.contraction_fixes_complement T p),
          ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.Stage.labels_of_contraction T p,

              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage.recover_target T ↑(T.lift.toFun p)).mp

                  (Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.Stage.lift_last T hD p))))
              hmem.right⟩⟩,
    mpr := fun a =>
      And.casesOn a fun hInit right =>
        And.casesOn right fun hLab hRV =>
          let q := (Fin.snoc (↑b).1 ((↑p).1 (Fin.last n) - DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.Stage.eps T hD b), (↑b).2);
          have hq :=
            (DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage.recover_target T q).mpr
              ⟨have hb :=
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrFun'

                            (congrArg Prod.mk
                              (Fin.init_snoc ((↑p).1 (Fin.last n) - DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.Stage.eps T hD b)
                                (↑b).1))
                            (↑b).2))
                        ↑b))
                    (Eq.refl ((↑b).1, (↑b).2));
                Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ T.contracted.carrier) hb)) b.property,
                Eq.mpr

                            (↑b).1)))
                      ((↑b).2 T.leading)))
                  hRV⟩;
          Exists.casesOn (Function.Bijective.surjective T.home.bijective ⟨q, hq⟩) fun p' hp' =>
            have hc :=
              Subtype.ext
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => _a = ↑b)
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage.contraction_value T p')))
                  (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (Fin.init (↑_a).1, (↑_a).2) = ↑b) hp'))
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrFun'

                              (congrArg Prod.mk
                                (Fin.init_snoc

              Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => Fin.init (↑p').1 = (↑_a).1) (Eq.symm hc)))

                                DiamondIntegral.Section7.Lemma720.Stage.eps T hD (T.contraction.toFun p'))

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

    {a b} F =>

    Set.ext fun w =>
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              _a ↔ w ∈ {w | ∃ u, w = DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join b.arity a.arity ↑u ↑(F.equiv u)})

          mp := fun a_1 =>
            Exists.casesOn a_1 fun x h =>
              And.casesOn h fun hx right =>
                Eq.symm right ▸
                  Exists.intro ⟨x, hx⟩

                      (id

                            DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join b.arity a.arity x _a =

                      (Eq.refl (DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join b.arity a.arity x ↑(F.equiv ⟨x, hx⟩)))),
          mpr := fun a_1 =>
            Exists.casesOn a_1 fun u h =>
              Eq.symm h ▸
                Exists.intro ↑u
                  ⟨u.property,
                    Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join b.arity a.arity ↑u ↑(F.equiv u) =

                      (Eq.refl (DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join b.arity a.arity ↑u ↑(F.equiv u)))⟩ };
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg
        (fun _a =>
          SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase { real := S, gamma := ∅ }
            (fun x => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv) _a)

    ∀ (a : Fin (n + 1) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) (t : Fin 0 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),

    {n r} {A} D hFinA a t =>
  have hsub := fun ⦃u⦄ a_1 =>
    And.casesOn a_1 fun hu right =>
      Exists.casesOn
        (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => (a, u) ∈ _a) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.ZeroCenteredData.image_carrier D)) hu)
        fun p h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hp he =>
          have h1 := congrArg Prod.fst he;
          have h2 :=
            Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a - D.shift (D.core p) = p.1) (Eq.symm h1)))
              (add_sub_cancel_right p.1 (D.shift (D.core p)));
          Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
            (Exists.intro (D.core p)
              (Exists.intro p.2
                ⟨⟨Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (_a, p.2) ∈ A.carrier) h2)) hp, funext fun i => Fin.elim0 i⟩,
                  congrArg Prod.snd he⟩));
  Set.Finite.subset (Set.finite_iUnion fun b => Set.Finite.image (fun v => D.tags v b) (hFinA (a - D.shift b) t)) hsub

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G : Type} [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G]

  {A : DiamondIntegral.Section6.DiamondCategory.VFObject (↑T) (n + 1 + 1)} {σ s : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1 + 1))}
  (G₀ : DiamondIntegral.Section6.NormalizedMeasuredContraction A.carrier A.form σ),
  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.reindexedVFSet G₀.normalization.map.image (σ * s)).carrier =

fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G}
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {T} {n} {A} {σ s} G₀ =>
  Set.ext fun q =>
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            _a ↔
              q ∈
                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.reindexedVFSet
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.reindexedVFSet G₀.normalization.map.image σ) s).carrier)
          (propext (DiamondIntegral.Section6.mem_reindexedVFSet G₀.normalization.map.image (σ * s) q))))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              DiamondIntegral.Section6.reindexVFPoint (Equiv.symm (σ * s)) q ∈ G₀.normalization.map.image.carrier ↔ _a)
            (propext
              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.mem_reindexedVFSet
                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.reindexedVFSet G₀.normalization.map.image σ) s q))))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                DiamondIntegral.Section6.reindexVFPoint (Equiv.symm (σ * s)) q ∈ G₀.normalization.map.image.carrier ↔
                  _a)
              (propext
                (DiamondIntegral.Section6.mem_reindexedVFSet G₀.normalization.map.image σ
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.reindexVFPoint (Equiv.symm s) q)))))
          (have he :=
            Prod.ext
              (funext fun k =>
                id
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg (fun _a => q.1 ((Equiv.symm _a) k) = q.1 ((Equiv.symm s) ((Equiv.symm σ) k)))
                        (Equiv.Perm.mul_def σ s)))
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg (fun _a => q.1 _a = q.1 ((Equiv.symm s) ((Equiv.symm σ) k)))
                          (Equiv.symm_trans_apply s σ k)))
                      (Eq.refl (q.1 ((Equiv.symm s) ((Equiv.symm σ) k)))))))
              rfl;
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  _a ∈ G₀.normalization.map.image.carrier ↔
                    DiamondIntegral.Section6.reindexVFPoint (Equiv.symm σ)
                        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.reindexVFPoint (Equiv.symm s) q) ∈
                      G₀.normalization.map.image.carrier)
                he))
            Iff.rfl)))

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductCells.defSet_eq_of_carrier : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {S : Set M} {P : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV M}

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductCells.defSet_eq_of_carrier : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {S : Set M} {P : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV M}
  {A A' : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet P S}, A'.carrier = A.carrier → A' = A :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} {P}
    {A A'} h =>
  SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.casesOn (motive := fun t => A = t → A' = A) A
    (fun carrier definable h_1 =>
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {A} => A'.carrier = A.carrier → A' = A)
        (fun h =>
          SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
            A' = t → A' = { carrier := carrier, definable := definable }) A'
            (fun carrier_1 definable_1 h_2 =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {A'} =>
                A'.carrier = { carrier := carrier, definable := definable }.carrier →
                  A' = { carrier := carrier, definable := definable })
                (fun h =>
                  Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a t =>
                    { carrier := carrier, definable := definable }.carrier = a →
                      h ≍ t →
                        { carrier := carrier_1, definable := definable_1 } =
                          { carrier := carrier, definable := definable })
                    h
                    (fun h_3 =>
                      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun carrier_2 =>
                        ∀ (definable_2 : P.Definable S carrier_2)
                          (h :
                            { carrier := carrier_2, definable := definable_2 }.carrier =
                              { carrier := carrier, definable := definable }.carrier),
                          h ≍ Eq.refl { carrier := carrier_2, definable := definable_2 }.carrier →
                            { carrier := carrier_2, definable := definable_2 } =
                              { carrier := carrier, definable := definable })
                        (fun definable_2 h h_4 => Eq.refl { carrier := carrier, definable := definable_2 }) h_3
                        definable_1 h)
                    (Eq.refl { carrier := carrier, definable := definable }.carrier) (HEq.refl h))
                (Eq.symm h_2) h)
            (Eq.refl A'))
        (Eq.symm h_1) h)
    (Eq.refl A)

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G : Type} [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G]

  {E : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 r) S}
  (H : DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage E) {z : Fin H.arity → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M},

    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {S} {r} {E} H {z} hz =>
  Exists.casesOn hz fun t ht =>
    Exists.casesOn (Function.Bijective.surjective H.home.bijective t) fun p hp =>
      have h2 := congrArg Prod.snd ht;
      Exists.intro (↑p).1
        (have hl :=
          funext fun i =>
            Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (↑p).2 i) Function.comp_apply))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a (H.oldLabels i) = (↑p).2 i) (Eq.symm h2)))
                (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (↑_a).2 (H.oldLabels i) = (↑p).2 i) (Eq.symm hp))) (H.retained p i)));
        Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => ((↑p).1, _a) ∈ E.carrier) hl)) p.property)

      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              _a ↔

          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>

                    _a)
                (propext (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductCells.mem_firstContracted hc hs hsmall P Q hP hPb HQ y w))))

              mp := fun a =>
                And.casesOn a fun left hy =>
                  And.casesOn left fun left right => And.casesOn right fun h2 h3 => ⟨hy, ⟨h2, h3⟩⟩,
              mpr := fun a =>
                And.casesOn a fun hy right => And.casesOn right fun h2 h3 => ⟨⟨Exists.intro y hy, ⟨h2, h3⟩⟩, hy⟩ }))

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G : Type} [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G]

  (P Q : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 m) S)
  (hP : DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S P.carrier) (hPb : DiamondIntegral.Section6.VFDoublyBounded P.carrier)
  (HP : DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage P) (HQ : DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage Q)
  (u : Fin (m + HQ.arity + HP.arity) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
  (Fin.elim0, u) ∈
      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductCells.secondStage hc hs hsmall P Q hP hPb HP HQ).contracted.carrier ↔
    (Fin.elim0, fun j => u (Fin.castAdd HP.arity (Fin.natAdd m j))) ∈ HQ.contracted.carrier ∧
      (∀ (i : Fin m),
          u (Fin.castAdd HP.arity (Fin.natAdd m (HQ.oldLabels i))) =
            u (Fin.castAdd HP.arity (Fin.castAdd HQ.arity i))) ∧
        (Fin.elim0, fun j => u (Fin.natAdd (m + HQ.arity) j)) ∈ HP.contracted.carrier ∧
          ∀ (i : Fin m),
            u (Fin.natAdd (m + HQ.arity) (HP.oldLabels i)) = u (Fin.castAdd HP.arity (Fin.castAdd HQ.arity i)) :=

    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {S} {m} hc {κ} hs hsmall P Q hP hPb HP
    HQ u =>
  id

      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.mem_pullbackStage_contracted
        (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductCells.labelSet hc hs hsmall P Q hP hPb HQ) (Fin.castAdd HQ.arity) HP

          (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductCells.labelSet_rvBounded hc hs hsmall P Q hP hPb HQ))
        (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.vfDoublyBounded_zero
          (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductCells.labelSet hc hs hsmall P Q hP hPb HQ).carrier)
        hc hs hsmall Fin.elim0 u)
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              (_a ∧
                  (Fin.elim0, fun j => u (Fin.natAdd (m + HQ.arity) j)) ∈ HP.contracted.carrier ∧
                    ∀ (i : Fin m),
                      u (Fin.natAdd (m + HQ.arity) (HP.oldLabels i)) =
                        u (Fin.castAdd HP.arity (Fin.castAdd HQ.arity i))) ↔
                (Fin.elim0, fun j => u (Fin.castAdd HP.arity (Fin.natAdd m j))) ∈ HQ.contracted.carrier ∧
                  (∀ (i : Fin m),
                      u (Fin.castAdd HP.arity (Fin.natAdd m (HQ.oldLabels i))) =

          mpr := fun a =>

                      ⟨hQ, hQl⟩⟩,
                    ⟨hPc, hPl⟩⟩ }))

              h2⟩,

      Exists.casesOn a fun u h =>

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductCells.imageProduct_of_product : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {r : ℕ}
  {X : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 2 r) S}
  (D : DiamondIntegral.Section6.ZeroCenteredData X),
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.VFDoublyBounded X.carrier →
    (∀ (x : Fin 2 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) (u : Fin r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
        (x, u) ∈ X.carrier ↔ (∃ y, (y, u) ∈ X.carrier ∧ y 0 = x 0) ∧ ∃ y, (y, u) ∈ X.carrier ∧ y 1 = x 1) →
      DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductCells.ImageProduct D :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} {r}
    {X} D hXb hprod =>
  have happ := fun u u' h =>
    funext fun i =>
      Eq.mp
        (congr (congrArg Eq (Fin.append_right (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false) u i))
          (Fin.append_right (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false) u' i))
        (congrFun h (Fin.natAdd 2 i));
  fun x w =>
  { mp := fun hx => ⟨Exists.intro x ⟨hx, rfl⟩, Exists.intro x ⟨hx, rfl⟩⟩,
    mpr := fun a =>
      And.casesOn a fun left right =>
        Exists.casesOn left fun y h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hy h0 =>
            Exists.casesOn right fun y' h =>
              And.casesOn h fun hy' h1 =>
                Exists.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductCells.mem_image_doublyBounded D hXb y w).mp hy)
                  fun u h =>
                  And.casesOn h fun hu right =>
                    Eq.ndrec (motive := fun w =>
                      (y, w) ∈ D.map.image.carrier → (y', w) ∈ D.map.image.carrier → (x, w) ∈ D.map.image.carrier)
                      (fun hy hy' =>
                        Exists.casesOn
                          ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductCells.mem_image_doublyBounded D hXb y'
                                (Fin.append (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false) u)).mp
                            hy')
                          fun u' h =>
                          And.casesOn h fun hu' hw =>
                            Eq.ndrec (motive := fun u' =>
                              (y', u') ∈ X.carrier →
                                Fin.append (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false) u =
                                    Fin.append (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false) u' →
                                  (x, Fin.append (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false) u) ∈
                                    D.map.image.carrier)
                              (fun hu' hw =>
                                (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductCells.mem_image_doublyBounded D hXb x
                                      (Fin.append (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false) u)).mpr
                                  (Exists.intro u
                                    ⟨(hprod x u).mpr ⟨Exists.intro y ⟨hu, h0⟩, Exists.intro y' ⟨hu', h1⟩⟩, rfl⟩))
                              (happ u u' hw) hu' hw)
                      (Eq.symm right) hy hy' }

                      (fun _a =>

DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductCells.blockSwap : (m a b : ℕ) → Fin (m + a + b) ≃ Fin (m + b + a)
def DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductCells.blockSwap : (m a b : ℕ) → Fin (m + a + b) ≃ Fin (m + b + a) :=
fun m a b =>
  finSumFinEquiv.symm.trans
    ((finSumFinEquiv.symm.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin b))).trans
      ((Equiv.sumAssoc (Fin m) (Fin a) (Fin b)).trans
        (((Equiv.refl (Fin m)).sumCongr (Equiv.sumComm (Fin a) (Fin b))).trans
          ((Equiv.sumAssoc (Fin m) (Fin b) (Fin a)).symm.trans
            ((finSumFinEquiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin a))).trans finSumFinEquiv)))))

  (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductCells.blockSwap m a b) (Fin.castAdd b (Fin.castAdd a i)) =
    Fin.castAdd a (Fin.castAdd b i)
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductCells.blockSwap_old : ∀ (m a b : ℕ) (i : Fin m),
  (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductCells.blockSwap m a b) (Fin.castAdd b (Fin.castAdd a i)) =
    Fin.castAdd a (Fin.castAdd b i) :=
fun m a b i =>
  of_eq_true
    (Eq.trans
      (congrFun'
        (congrArg Eq
          (Eq.trans
            (congrArg
              (⇑((finSumFinEquiv.symm.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin b))).trans
                  ((Equiv.sumAssoc (Fin m) (Fin a) (Fin b)).trans
                    (((Equiv.refl (Fin m)).sumCongr (Equiv.sumComm (Fin a) (Fin b))).trans
                      ((Equiv.sumAssoc (Fin m) (Fin b) (Fin a)).symm.trans
                        ((finSumFinEquiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin a))).trans finSumFinEquiv))))))
              (finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_castAdd (Fin.castAdd a i)))
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg
                (⇑((Equiv.sumAssoc (Fin m) (Fin a) (Fin b)).trans
                    (((Equiv.refl (Fin m)).sumCongr (Equiv.sumComm (Fin a) (Fin b))).trans
                      ((Equiv.sumAssoc (Fin m) (Fin b) (Fin a)).symm.trans
                        ((finSumFinEquiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin a))).trans finSumFinEquiv)))))
                (Eq.trans (Equiv.sumCongr_apply finSumFinEquiv.symm (Equiv.refl (Fin b)) (Sum.inl (Fin.castAdd a i)))
                  (congrArg Sum.inl (finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_castAdd i))))
              (Eq.trans
                (congrArg

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductKinds.product_of_kind : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G : Type} [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G]
  [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G],
  (∀ (x y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
      SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.VFValued.predV x y ↔ Valued.v x ≤ Valued.v y) →
    ∀ {C : Set (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M × DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)}
      {ε : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M} {t : DiamondIntegral.Section2.RV M}
      {t₁ : DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M} {k : Fin 3},
      DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCellInput.CellWith C ε t t₁ k →
        k ≠ 2 →
          ∀ (a b : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
            (a, b) ∈ C ↔
              a ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.first C ∧ b ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.second C :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G}
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] hv {C} {ε} {t} {t₁} {k} h hk a b =>
  have hfe := DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductKinds.fibres_eq_of_kind hv h hk;
  { mp := fun hab => ⟨Exists.intro (a, b) ⟨hab, rfl⟩, Exists.intro (a, b) ⟨hab, rfl⟩⟩,
    mpr := fun a_1 =>
      And.casesOn a_1 fun left right =>
        Exists.casesOn left fun w h =>
          Prod.casesOn (motive := fun x => x ∈ C ∧ x.1 = a → (a, b) ∈ C) w
            (fun a' b' h =>
              And.casesOn h fun hab' right_1 =>
                right_1 ▸
                  Exists.casesOn right fun w h =>
                    Prod.casesOn (motive := fun x => x ∈ C ∧ x.2 = b → ((a', b').1, b) ∈ C) w
                      (fun a'' b'' h =>
                        And.casesOn h fun hab'' right =>
                          right ▸
                            have h1 := hab'';
                            have ha' := Exists.intro (a', b') ⟨hab', rfl⟩;
                            have ha'' := Exists.intro (a'', b'') ⟨hab'', rfl⟩;
                            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => b'' ∈ _a) (hfe a'' ha'' a' ha')) h1)
                      h)
            h }

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductKinds.kind_ne_two : ∀ {k : Fin 3}, k ≠ 2 ↔ k = 0 ∨ k = 1
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductKinds.kind_ne_two : ∀ {k : Fin 3}, k ≠ 2 ↔ k = 0 ∨ k = 1 :=
fun {k} =>
  {
    mp := fun h =>
      match k, h with
      | 0, x => Or.inl rfl
      | 1, x => Or.inr rfl
      | 2, h => absurd rfl h,
    mpr := fun a =>
      Or.casesOn a (fun h => Eq.symm h ▸ of_decide_eq_true (id (Eq.refl true))) fun h =>
        Eq.symm h ▸ of_decide_eq_true (id (Eq.refl true)) }

              (fun _a =>

                  SpecialTransformations.Section4.rvValues _a)

                    Exists.intro s ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductKinds.kind_ne_two.mpr (Or.inl hk), (hinj s).mp hs⟩)
              fun h =>
              Exists.casesOn h fun s h =>
                And.casesOn h fun hk hs =>
                  Exists.intro s ⟨DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductKinds.kind_ne_two.mpr (Or.inr hk), (hinj s).mp hs⟩,
          mpr := fun a =>
            Exists.casesOn a fun s h =>
              And.casesOn h fun hk hs =>
                Or.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProductKinds.kind_ne_two.mp hk)
                  (fun hk => Or.inl (Exists.intro s ⟨hk, (hinj s).mpr hs⟩)) fun hk =>

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProgramContractions.tagSet_properInvariant : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} (m : ℕ) {n r : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S},
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S A.carrier →
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProgramContractions.tagSet m A).carrier :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} m
    {n r} {A} hA =>
  { definable := (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProgramContractions.tagSet m A).definable,
    vfBounded :=
      Exists.casesOn hA.vfBounded fun γ hγ =>
        Exists.intro γ fun q hq i =>
          hγ (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProgramContractions.untagPoint m q)
            ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProgramContractions.mem_tagSet m A q).mp hq).right i,
    rvBounded :=
      Exists.casesOn hA.rvBounded fun γ hγ =>
        let δ := max 1 γ;
        have hlow :=
          have this := inv_le_inv' (le_max_right 1 γ);
          this;
        have hlow1 :=
          have this :=
            Eq.mp (congrArg (LE.le δ⁻¹) inv_one)
              (inv_le_inv'
                (have this := le_max_left 1 γ;
                this));
          this;
        have hhigh := le_max_right ↑1 ↑γ;
        have hhigh1 :=
          have this := le_max_left 1 γ;
          this;
        Exists.intro δ fun q hq i =>
          And.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProgramContractions.mem_tagSet m A q).mp hq) fun hT hU =>
            Fin.addCases
              (fun i =>
                Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg
                      (fun _a =>
                        ↑δ⁻¹ ≤ SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv _a ∧
                          SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vrv _a ≤ ↑δ)
                      (hT i)))
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id (congrArg (fun _a => ↑δ⁻¹ ≤ _a ∧ _a ≤ ↑δ) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag_value false)))
                    ⟨hlow1, hhigh1⟩))
              (fun j =>
                ⟨LE.le.trans hlow (hγ (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProgramContractions.untagPoint m q) hU j).left,
                  LE.le.trans (hγ (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProgramContractions.untagPoint m q) hU j).right hhigh⟩)
              i,
    radii := fun w =>
      Exists.casesOn (hA.radii fun j => w (Fin.natAdd m j)) fun α h =>
        And.casesOn h fun hα hInv =>
          Exists.intro α
            ⟨fun i =>
              Set.Definable.mono (hα i)
                (Set.union_subset_union_right S fun z x =>
                  match x with
                  | Exists.intro l hl => Exists.intro (Fin.natAdd m l) hl),
              fun a b hab =>
              id
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg
                      (fun _a => _a ↔ (b, w) ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProgramContractions.tagSet m A).carrier)
                      (propext (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProgramContractions.mem_tagSet m A (a, w)))))
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg
                        (fun _a =>
                          DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProgramContractions.Tagged m (a, w).2 ∧
                              DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProgramContractions.untagPoint m (a, w) ∈ A.carrier ↔
                            _a)
                        (propext (DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProgramContractions.mem_tagSet m A (b, w)))))
                    (and_congr Iff.rfl (hInv a b hab))))⟩ }

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProgramContractions.labelMap_source : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] {S : Set M} {n r s : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  {B : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n s) S}
  (f : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Map A B),
  (∀ (p : ↑A.carrier), (↑(f.toFun p)).1 = (↑p).1) →
    (∀ (p p' : ↑A.carrier), (↑p).2 = (↑p').2 → (↑(f.toFun p)).2 = (↑(f.toFun p')).2) →
      ∀ (u : Fin r → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) (v : Fin s → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource f u v =
          if ∃ p, (↑p).2 = u ∧ (↑(f.toFun p)).2 = v then DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfFibre A.carrier u else ∅ :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] {S} {n r s} {A} {B} f hVF hLab u v =>
  Set.ext fun x =>
    if h : ∃ p, (↑p).2 = u ∧ (↑(f.toFun p)).2 = v then
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (Iff (x ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource f u v))
            (congrFun' (congrArg Membership.mem (ite_eq_left h)) x)))
        {
          mp := fun a =>
            Exists.casesOn a fun y h => Exists.casesOn h fun p h => And.casesOn h fun hp hfp => id (hp ▸ p.property),
          mpr := fun hx =>
            Exists.casesOn h fun p h =>
              And.casesOn h fun hpu hpv =>
                let p' := ⟨(x, u), hx⟩;
                Exists.intro x (Exists.intro p' ⟨rfl, Prod.ext (hVF p') (Eq.trans (hLab p' p (Eq.symm hpu)) hpv)⟩) }
    else
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (Iff (x ∈ DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibreSource f u v))
            (congrFun' (congrArg Membership.mem (ite_eq_right h)) x)))
        {
          mp := fun a =>
            Exists.casesOn a fun y h_1 =>
              Exists.casesOn h_1 fun p h_2 =>
                And.casesOn h_2 fun hp hfp =>
                  False.elim (h (Exists.intro p ⟨congrArg Prod.snd hp, congrArg Prod.snd hfp⟩)),
          mpr := fun hx => False.elim hx }

  Function.Injective f → Function.Injective (Fin.append (Fin.castAdd c) fun j => Fin.natAdd a (f j))
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProgramContractions.append_labels_injective : ∀ {a b c : ℕ} {f : Fin b → Fin c},
  Function.Injective f → Function.Injective (Fin.append (Fin.castAdd c) fun j => Fin.natAdd a (f j)) :=
fun {a b c} {f} hf ⦃x y⦄ h =>
  Fin.addCases (motive := fun ⦃x⦄ =>
    Fin.append (Fin.castAdd c) (fun j => Fin.natAdd a (f j)) x =
        Fin.append (Fin.castAdd c) (fun j => Fin.natAdd a (f j)) y →
      x = y)
    (fun i h =>
      Fin.addCases (motive := fun ⦃y⦄ =>
        Fin.append (Fin.castAdd c) (fun j => Fin.natAdd a (f j)) (Fin.castAdd b i) =
            Fin.append (Fin.castAdd c) (fun j => Fin.natAdd a (f j)) y →
          Fin.castAdd b i = y)
        (fun i' h =>
          have h' :=
            congrArg Fin.val
              (Eq.mp
                (congrArg (fun _a => Fin.castAdd c i = _a)
                  (Fin.append_left (Fin.castAdd c) (fun j => Fin.natAdd a (f j)) i'))
                (Eq.mp
                  (congrArg (fun _a => _a = Fin.append (Fin.castAdd c) (fun j => Fin.natAdd a (f j)) (Fin.castAdd b i'))
                    (Fin.append_left (Fin.castAdd c) (fun j => Fin.natAdd a (f j)) i))
                  h));
          congrArg (Fin.castAdd b) (Fin.ext h'))
        (fun j' h =>
          have h' :=
            congrArg Fin.val
              (Eq.mp
                (congrArg (fun _a => Fin.castAdd c i = _a)
                  (Fin.append_right (Fin.castAdd c) (fun j => Fin.natAdd a (f j)) j'))
                (Eq.mp
                  (congrArg (fun _a => _a = Fin.append (Fin.castAdd c) (fun j => Fin.natAdd a (f j)) (Fin.natAdd a j'))
                    (Fin.append_left (Fin.castAdd c) (fun j => Fin.natAdd a (f j)) i))
                  h));
          absurd h' fun a_1 => DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProgramContractions.append_labels_injective._proof_1_1 i j' h')
        y h)
    (fun j h =>
      Fin.addCases (motive := fun ⦃y⦄ =>
        Fin.append (Fin.castAdd c) (fun j => Fin.natAdd a (f j)) (Fin.natAdd a j) =
            Fin.append (Fin.castAdd c) (fun j => Fin.natAdd a (f j)) y →
          Fin.natAdd a j = y)
        (fun i' h =>
          have h' :=
            congrArg Fin.val
              (Eq.mp
                (congrArg (fun _a => Fin.natAdd a (f j) = _a)
                  (Fin.append_left (Fin.castAdd c) (fun j => Fin.natAdd a (f j)) i'))
                (Eq.mp
                  (congrArg (fun _a => _a = Fin.append (Fin.castAdd c) (fun j => Fin.natAdd a (f j)) (Fin.castAdd b i'))
                    (Fin.append_right (Fin.castAdd c) (fun j => Fin.natAdd a (f j)) j))
                  h));
          absurd h' fun a_1 => DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProgramContractions.append_labels_injective._proof_1_2 j i' h')
        (fun j' h =>
          have h' :=
            congrArg Fin.val
              (Eq.mp
                (congrArg (fun _a => Fin.natAdd a (f j) = _a)
                  (Fin.append_right (Fin.castAdd c) (fun j => Fin.natAdd a (f j)) j'))
                (Eq.mp
                  (congrArg (fun _a => _a = Fin.append (Fin.castAdd c) (fun j => Fin.natAdd a (f j)) (Fin.natAdd a j'))
                    (Fin.append_right (Fin.castAdd c) (fun j => Fin.natAdd a (f j)) j))
                  h));
          have hfj :=
            Fin.ext
              (Decidable.byContradiction fun a_1 =>
                DiamondIntegral.Section7.ProgramContractions.append_labels_injective._proof_1_3 j j' h' a_1);
          Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => Fin.natAdd a _a = Fin.natAdd a j') (hf hfj))) (Eq.refl (Fin.natAdd a j')))
        y h)
    x h

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

    {n q r k} {Z} {D} {E} σ τ hZ hD hE =>
  Exists.casesOn hD fun γ hγ =>
    Exists.casesOn hE fun δ hδ =>
      Exists.intro (min γ δ) fun p hp i =>

  Exists.casesOn hD fun γ hγ =>

      have h1 := inv_le_inv' (le_max_left γ δ);
      have h2 := inv_le_inv' (le_max_right γ δ);

  have hmaps := fun ⦃x⦄ hx =>

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

  {τ : (Fin b → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) → Fin d → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M}

    (Fin a → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) →
      (Fin b → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M) → Set (Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)},

    ∀ (hbij : Function.Bijective f.toFun) (hhbij : Function.Bijective h.toFun),
      DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.IsGraphProduct (f.inverse hbij) (h.inverse hhbij) τ σ fun v u => K u v :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n a b c d} {A} {B} {E} {F} {f} {h} {σ} {τ} {K} hf hbij hhbij =>
  {
    graph := fun v u y x =>
      Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              _a ↔
                Fin.init y ∈ K u v ∧
                  Fin.init x = Fin.init y ∧
                    DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibre (h.inverse hhbij) (τ v) (σ u) (fun x => y (Fin.last n))
                      fun x_1 => x (Fin.last n))

        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                _a ↔
                  Fin.init y ∈ K u v ∧
                    Fin.init x = Fin.init y ∧
                      DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibre (h.inverse hhbij) (τ v) (σ u) (fun x => y (Fin.last n))
                        fun x_1 => x (Fin.last n))

            (id

                (fun _a =>
                  (Fin.init x ∈ K u v ∧
                      Fin.init y = Fin.init x ∧
                        DiamondIntegral.Section6.graphFibre h (σ u) (τ v) (fun x_1 => x (Fin.last n)) fun x =>
                          y (Fin.last n)) ↔
                    Fin.init y ∈ K u v ∧ Fin.init x = Fin.init y ∧ _a)
                (propext
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section6.inverse_graphFibre_iff h hhbij (σ u) (τ v) (fun x_1 => x (Fin.last n))
                    fun x => y (Fin.last n)))))

              mp := fun a =>
                And.casesOn a fun hK right => And.casesOn right fun hxy hh => ⟨Eq.symm hxy ▸ hK, ⟨Eq.symm hxy, hh⟩⟩,

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.blockLinear_det : ∀ {M : Type}

    (Fin 1 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) →ₗ[DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M] Fin 1 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
  (LinearMap.toMatrix' (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.blockLinear L₁)).det = (LinearMap.toMatrix' L₁).det
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.blockLinear_det : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n : ℕ}
  (L₁ :
    (Fin 1 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) →ₗ[DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M] Fin 1 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
  (LinearMap.toMatrix' (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.blockLinear L₁)).det = (LinearMap.toMatrix' L₁).det :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n}
    L₁ =>
  have hlow := fun ⦃i k⦄ hik =>
    have hik' := OrderDual.toDual_lt_toDual.mp hik;
    have hi := fun a =>
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun ⦃i⦄ => OrderDual.toDual k < OrderDual.toDual i → i < k → False)
        (fun hik hik' => LE.le.not_gt (Fin.le_last k) hik') (Eq.symm a) hik hik';
    Exists.casesOn (Fin.exists_castSucc_eq.mpr hi) fun j h =>
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun ⦃i⦄ =>
        OrderDual.toDual k < OrderDual.toDual i →
          i < k → i ≠ Fin.last n → LinearMap.toMatrix' (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.blockLinear L₁) i k = 0)
        (fun hik hik' hi =>
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 0)
                (LinearMap.toMatrix'_apply (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.blockLinear L₁) j.castSucc k)))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a => _a j.castSucc = 0)
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.blockLinear_apply L₁ (Pi.single k 1))))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 0)
                    (Fin.snoc_castSucc (L₁ (fun x => Pi.single k 1 (Fin.last n)) 0) (Fin.init (Pi.single k 1)) j)))
                (Pi.single_eq_of_ne (ne_of_lt hik') 1))))
        h hik hik' hi;
  have hdiag := fun j =>
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 1)
          (LinearMap.toMatrix'_apply (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.blockLinear L₁) j.castSucc j.castSucc)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg (fun _a => _a j.castSucc = 1)
            (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.blockLinear_apply L₁ (Pi.single j.castSucc 1))))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a => _a = 1)
              (Fin.snoc_castSucc (L₁ (fun x => Pi.single j.castSucc 1 (Fin.last n)) 0)
                (Fin.init (Pi.single j.castSucc 1)) j)))
          (Pi.single_eq_same j.castSucc 1)));
  have hlast :=
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = LinearMap.toMatrix' L₁ 0 0)
          (LinearMap.toMatrix'_apply (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.blockLinear L₁) (Fin.last n)
            (Fin.last n))))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.blockLinear L₁) (Pi.single (Fin.last n) 1) (Fin.last n) = _a)
            (LinearMap.toMatrix'_apply L₁ 0 0)))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a => _a (Fin.last n) = L₁ (Pi.single 0 1) 0)
              (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.blockLinear_apply L₁ (Pi.single (Fin.last n) 1))))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a => _a = L₁ (Pi.single 0 1) 0)
                (Fin.snoc_last (L₁ (fun x => Pi.single (Fin.last n) 1 (Fin.last n)) 0)
                  (Fin.init (Pi.single (Fin.last n) 1)))))
            (have hx :=
              funext fun i =>
                Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => Pi.single (Fin.last n) 1 (Fin.last n) = Pi.single 0 1 _a)
                      (Subsingleton.elim i 0)))
                  (of_eq_true
                    (Eq.trans (congr (congrArg Eq (Pi.single_eq_same (Fin.last n) 1)) (Pi.single_eq_same 0 1))
                      (eq_self 1)));
            Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => L₁ _a 0 = L₁ (Pi.single 0 1) 0) hx)) (Eq.refl (L₁ (Pi.single 0 1) 0))))));
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (LinearMap.toMatrix' L₁).det)
        (Matrix.det_of_isLowerTriangular (LinearMap.toMatrix' (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.blockLinear L₁))
          hlow)))
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a => _a = (LinearMap.toMatrix' L₁).det)
          (Fin.prod_univ_castSucc fun i =>
            LinearMap.toMatrix' (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.blockLinear L₁) i i)))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrArg
            (fun _a =>
              (∏ i,
                    LinearMap.toMatrix' (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.blockLinear L₁) i.castSucc
                      i.castSucc) *
                  LinearMap.toMatrix' (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.blockLinear L₁) (Fin.last n)
                    (Fin.last n) =
                _a)
            (Matrix.det_fin_one (LinearMap.toMatrix' L₁))))
        (of_eq_true
          (Eq.trans
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg Eq
                (Eq.trans
                  (congr
                    (congrArg HMul.hMul
                      (Eq.trans (Finset.prod_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a => (fun j => hdiag j) x)
                        Finset.prod_const_one))
                    hlast)
                  (one_mul (LinearMap.toMatrix' L₁ 0 0))))
              (LinearMap.toMatrix' L₁ 0 0))
            (eq_self (LinearMap.toMatrix' L₁ 0 0))))))

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.hasVFDerivativeAt_block : ∀ {M : Type}

  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n : ℕ}

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.hasVFDerivativeAt_block : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n : ℕ}
  {F₁ : (Fin 1 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) → Fin 1 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M}
  {L₁ : (Fin 1 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) →ₗ[DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M] Fin 1 → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M}
  {a : Fin (n + 1) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M},
  SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasVFDerivativeAt F₁ (fun x => a (Fin.last n)) L₁ →
    SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasVFDerivativeAt
      (fun x => Fin.snoc (Fin.init x) (F₁ (fun x_1 => x (Fin.last n)) 0)) a
      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.blockLinear L₁) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n} {F₁}
    {L₁} {a} h =>
  SpecialTransformations.Section9.hasVFDerivativeAt_of_components
    (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.blockLinear L₁) fun i =>
    Fin.lastCases (motive := fun x =>
      ∀ (ε : SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.Gamma),
        ∃ δ,
          ∀ (h : Fin (n + 1) → SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType),
            h ≠ 0 →
              ↑δ < SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfTupleValue h →
                ↑ε * SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfTupleValue h <
                  SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom
                    (Fin.snoc (Fin.init (a + h)) (F₁ (fun x => (a + h) (Fin.last n)) 0) x -
                        Fin.snoc (Fin.init a) (F₁ (fun x => a (Fin.last n)) 0) x -
                      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.blockLinear L₁) h x))
      (fun ε =>
        Exists.casesOn (SpecialTransformations.Section9.HasVFDerivativeAt.component h 0 ε) fun δ hδ =>
          Exists.intro δ fun b hb hbδ =>
            have e1 := rfl;
            Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (LT.lt (↑ε * SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfTupleValue b))
                  (congrArg (⇑SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom)
                    (congr
                      (congrArg HSub.hSub
                        (congr
                          (congrArg HSub.hSub (Fin.snoc_last (F₁ (fun x => (a + b) (Fin.last n)) 0) (Fin.init (a + b))))
                          (Fin.snoc_last (F₁ (fun x => a (Fin.last n)) 0) (Fin.init a))))
                      (Fin.snoc_last (L₁ (fun x => b (Fin.last n)) 0) (Fin.init b))))))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg
                    (fun _a =>
                      ↑ε * SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfTupleValue b <
                        SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom
                          (F₁ _a 0 - F₁ (fun x => a (Fin.last n)) 0 - L₁ (fun x => b (Fin.last n)) 0))
                    e1))
                (if hb0 : b (Fin.last n) = 0 then
                  have hz := funext fun x => hb0;
                  Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg (LT.lt (↑ε * SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfTupleValue b))
                        (Eq.trans
                          (congrArg (⇑SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom)
                            (Eq.trans
                              (congr
                                (congrArg HSub.hSub
                                  (Eq.trans
                                    (congrFun'
                                      (congrArg HSub.hSub
                                        (congrFun'
                                          (congrArg F₁
                                            (Eq.trans (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd fun x => a (Fin.last n)) hz)
                                              (add_zero fun x => a (Fin.last n))))
                                          0))
                                      (F₁ (fun x => a (Fin.last n)) 0))
                                    (sub_self (F₁ (fun x => a (Fin.last n)) 0))))
                                (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg (⇑L₁) hz) 0) (congrFun (map_zero L₁) 0)))
                              (sub_self 0)))
                          (map_zero SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom))))
                    (SpecialTransformations.Section9.value_lt_infinity
                      (mul_ne_zero (SpecialTransformations.Section9.finiteValue_ne_zero ε)
                        (SpecialTransformations.Section9.vfTupleValue_ne_zero hb)))
                else
                  have hb1 := fun h => hb0 (congrFun h 0);
                  have hcomp :=
                    Exists.casesOn
                      (SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfTupleValue_eq_component (fun x => b (Fin.last n))
                        Nat.zero_lt_one)
                      fun k hk =>
                      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfTupleValue b ≤ _a) hk))
                        (SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfTupleValue_le_component b (Fin.last n));
                  LE.le.trans_lt (mul_le_mul' le_rfl hcomp)
                    (hδ (fun x => b (Fin.last n)) hb1 (LT.lt.trans_le hbδ hcomp)))))
      (fun j ε =>
        Exists.intro 1 fun b hb x =>
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (LT.lt (↑ε * SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfTupleValue b))
                (congrArg (⇑SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom)
                  (congr
                    (congrArg HSub.hSub
                      (congr
                        (congrArg HSub.hSub
                          (Fin.snoc_castSucc (F₁ (fun x => a (Fin.last n) + b (Fin.last n)) 0) (Fin.init (a + b)) j))
                        (Fin.snoc_castSucc (F₁ (fun x => a (Fin.last n)) 0) (Fin.init a) j)))
                    (Fin.snoc_castSucc (L₁ (fun x => b (Fin.last n)) 0) (Fin.init b) j)))))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    ↑ε * SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfTupleValue b <
                      SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom _a)
                  (have this := DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.hasVFDerivativeAt_block._abel_1_1 j b;
                  this)))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => ↑ε * SpecialTransformations.Section8.vfTupleValue b < _a)
                    (map_zero SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom)))
                (SpecialTransformations.Section9.value_lt_infinity
                  (mul_ne_zero (SpecialTransformations.Section9.finiteValue_ne_zero ε)
                    (SpecialTransformations.Section9.vfTupleValue_ne_zero hb))))))
      i

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.mem_pullbackTarget_contracted : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {n q r : ℕ}
  {E : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 r) S}
  (D : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n q) S)
  (π : Fin r → Fin q) (H : DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage E)
  (x : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) (w' : Fin (q + H.arity) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
  (x, w') ∈
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfDropLast
            (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.pullbackTarget D H.target π H.oldLabels)).image.carrier ↔

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.mem_pullbackTarget_contracted : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {G : Type}
  [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {n q r : ℕ}
  {E : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace 1 r) S}
  (D : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n q) S)
  (π : Fin r → Fin q) (H : DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage E)
  (x : Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) (w' : Fin (q + H.arity) → DiamondIntegral.Section2.RVInfinity M),
  (x, w') ∈
      (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfDropLast
            (DiamondIntegral.Section7.PullbackStages.pullbackTarget D H.target π H.oldLabels)).image.carrier ↔
    (x, fun i => w' (Fin.castAdd H.arity i)) ∈ D.carrier ∧
      (Fin.elim0, fun j => w' (Fin.natAdd q j)) ∈ H.contracted.carrier ∧
        ∀ (i : Fin r), w' (Fin.natAdd q (H.oldLabels i)) = w' (Fin.castAdd H.arity (π i)) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S} {G}
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {n q r} {E} D π H x w' =>
  {
    mp := fun a =>
      Exists.casesOn a fun a ha =>
        have h1 :=
          have h := congrArg Prod.fst ha;
          h;
        have h2 :=
          have h := congrArg Prod.snd ha;
          h;
        And.casesOn a.property fun haD right =>
          And.casesOn right fun haT hal =>
            ⟨Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (_a, fun i => w' (Fin.castAdd H.arity i)) ∈ D.carrier) (Eq.symm h1)))
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => (Fin.init (↑a).1, fun i => _a (Fin.castAdd H.arity i)) ∈ D.carrier)
                      (Eq.symm h2)))
                  haD),
              ⟨Exists.intro ⟨(fun x => (↑a).1 (Fin.last n), fun j => (↑a).2 (Fin.natAdd q j)), haT⟩
                  (id
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            (Fin.init fun x => (↑a).1 (Fin.last n), fun j => _a (Fin.natAdd q j)) =
                              (Fin.elim0, fun j => w' (Fin.natAdd q j)))
                          h2))
                      (Prod.ext
                        (Subsingleton.elim (Fin.init fun x => (↑a).1 (Fin.last n), fun j => w' (Fin.natAdd q j)).1
                          (Fin.elim0, fun j => w' (Fin.natAdd q j)).1)
                        rfl))),
                fun i =>
                Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => _a (Fin.natAdd q (H.oldLabels i)) = _a (Fin.castAdd H.arity (π i)))
                      (Eq.symm h2)))
                  (hal i)⟩⟩,
    mpr := fun a =>
      And.casesOn a fun hD' right =>
        And.casesOn right fun left hlab =>
          Exists.casesOn left fun b hb =>
            have hb2 :=
              have h := congrArg Prod.snd hb;
              h;
            have hT :=
              have he :=
                Prod.ext
                  (DiamondIntegral.Section7.FibreRestriction.fin_one_ext
                    (of_eq_true
                      (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg Eq (Fin.snoc_last ((↑b).1 0) x)) ((↑b).1 0))
                        (eq_self ((↑b).1 0)))))
                  (Eq.symm hb2);
              Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ H.target.carrier) he)) b.property;
            Exists.intro
              ⟨(Fin.snoc x ((↑b).1 0), w'),
                ⟨id
                    (Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg (fun _a => (_a, fun i => w' (Fin.castAdd H.arity i)) ∈ D.carrier)
                          (Fin.init_snoc ((↑b).1 0) x)))
                      hD'),
                  ⟨hT, hlab⟩⟩⟩
              (id
                (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => (_a, w') = (x, w')) (Fin.init_snoc ((↑b).1 0) x)))
                  (Eq.refl (x, w')))) }

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.RVMaps.scalarDef_coord : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.RVMaps.scalarDef_coord : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {B : SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.Base} {n : ℕ} {I : Set (Fin n → M)},
  SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase B
      (fun x => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv) I →
    ∀ (p : Fin n), DiamondIntegral.Section7.RVMaps.ScalarDef B I fun u => u p :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {B} {n}
    {I} hI p =>
  have h := DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVCoordinateMaps.coordinate_graph_definable B I hI ![p];
  have he :=
    funext fun u =>
      funext fun i =>
        List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a x =>
          List.finRange (Nat.succ 0) = a → Fintype.complete i ≍ x → (u ∘ ![p]) i = ![u p] i) (Fintype.complete i)
          (fun as h =>
            List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun i =>
                ∀ (this : i ∈ Fintype.elems), [] ≍ as → this ≍ List.Mem.head as → (u ∘ ![p]) i = ![u p] i)
                (fun this tail_eq =>
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun as =>
                    this ≍ List.Mem.head as →
                      (u ∘ ![p]) ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl (Nat.succ 0)⟩) =
                        ![u p] ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl (Nat.succ 0)⟩))
                    (fun h => Eq.refl ((u ∘ ![p]) ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl (Nat.succ 0)⟩))) (eq_of_heq tail_eq))
                (eq_of_heq head_eq) (Fintype.complete i))
          (fun b {as} a h =>
            List.cons.noConfusion h fun head_eq =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun b => [] ≍ as → Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail b a → (u ∘ ![p]) i = ![u p] i)
                (fun tail_eq =>
                  Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {as} =>
                    ∀ (a : List.Mem i as),
                      Fintype.complete i ≍ List.Mem.tail ((fun i => i) ⟨0, Nat.le_refl (Nat.succ 0)⟩) a →
                        (u ∘ ![p]) i = ![u p] i)
                    (fun a h =>
                      List.Mem.casesOn (motive := fun a_1 x => [] = a_1 → a ≍ x → (u ∘ ![p]) i = ![u p] i) a
                        (fun as h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h))
                        (fun b {as} a_1 h => False.elim (noConfusion_of_Nat List.ctorIdx h)) (Eq.refl []) (HEq.refl a))
                    (eq_of_heq tail_eq) a)
                (eq_of_heq head_eq))
          (Eq.refl (List.finRange (Nat.succ 0))) (HEq.refl (Fintype.complete i));
  id
    (Eq.mpr
      (id

  p.2 ∉ R.activeTags.carrier → R.point p = (p.1, Fin.append (fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag false) p.2) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}

                    ((DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue_eq_infinity_iff 0).mpr rfl))
                  hlt)))));
  id
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.Remark74.aperture_value_family_definable : ∀ {M : Type}

      {SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue (τ.aperture u)}) :=
