    {k} {S} r τ =>
  let I :=
    {w |
        w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex 1 r.arity ∈ r.domain ∧
          w ∈
            SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.sortedUniverse fun x =>
              SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv} \
      DiamondIntegral.Section7.StrictCharts.coordEq (DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex 1 r.arity 0)
        SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRVZero;
  have hI :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVChartRestrictions.difference_definable { real := S, gamma := ∅ }
      {w |
        w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex 1 r.arity ∈ r.domain ∧
          w ∈
            SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.sortedUniverse fun x =>
              SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv}
      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.StrictCharts.coordEq (DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex 1 r.arity 0)
        SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRVZero)
      (SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.DefinableOverBase.preimage_real r.domain_definable
        (fun x => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.SortTag.rv)
        (DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex 1 r.arity))
      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.StrictCharts.coordEq_definable
        (DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex 1 r.arity 0)
        (DiamondIntegral.Section4.RVNamedTuples.zero_definable { real := S, gamma := ∅ }));
  have hz := fun w hw =>
    ⟨hw.left.right (DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex 1 r.arity 0), fun h =>
      hw.right ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.StrictCharts.mem_coordEq hw.left.right).mpr h)⟩;
  have hhead := fun w hw => hw.left.left;
  have hτ :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section7.RVMaps.scalarDef_comp
      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.RVMaps.tupleDef_coord hI
        (DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex 1 r.arity))
      τ.graph_definable hhead;
  have hτn := fun w hw => τ.nonzero (w ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex 1 r.arity) (hhead hw);
  have h1 :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section7.RVMaps.le_definable hI
      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.RVMaps.scalarDef_coord hI
        (DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex 1 r.arity 0))

    DiamondIntegral.Section7.RVMaps.le_definable hI hτ

                  SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue
                    (u (DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex 1 r.arity 0))}))
        (Set.ext fun z =>
          have hzh :=
            funext fun i =>
              of_eq_true
                (Eq.trans
                  (congrFun'
                    (congrArg Eq
                      (congrArg z (DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join_head 1 r.arity Sum.inl Sum.inr i)))
                    (z (Sum.inl i)))
                  (eq_self (z (Sum.inl i))));
          have hzt :=
            of_eq_true
              (Eq.trans
                (congrFun'
                  (congrArg Eq
                    (congrArg z (DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.join_tail 1 r.arity Sum.inl Sum.inr 0)))
                  (z (Sum.inr 0)))
                (eq_self (z (Sum.inr 0))));
          {
            mp := fun a =>
              And.casesOn a fun hd right =>
                And.casesOn right fun hn hv =>
                  have hsort := fun i =>
                    Or.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section7.StrictCharts.block_cases 1 r.arity i)
                      (fun h =>
                        Exists.casesOn h fun i' h =>
                          Eq.symm h ▸
                            id
                              (Eq.mpr
                                (id
                                  (congrArg (fun _a => SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRV _a)

                                  r.domain_definable (z ∘ Sum.inl) hd i')))

                      hn.right

                          ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.StrictCharts.mem_coordEq hsort).mp hc))⟩;
                  have hv' :=
                    Eq.mpr
                      (id
                        (congrArg
                          (fun _a =>
                            SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue _a =
                              SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue
                                (τ.aperture ((z ∘ σ) ∘ DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.headIndex 1 r.arity)))
                          hzt))
                      (Eq.mpr
                        (id
                          (congrArg
                            (fun _a =>
                              SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue (z (Sum.inr 0)) =
                                SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue (τ.aperture _a))
                            hzh))
                        hv);
                  ⟨⟨hIz, Eq.le hv'⟩, ⟨hIz, Eq.ge hv'⟩⟩,
            mpr := fun a =>
              And.casesOn a fun left right =>
                And.casesOn left fun hIz hle =>
                  And.casesOn right fun left hge =>
                    have hd := hzh ▸ hIz.left.left;
                    have hn := hzt ▸ hz (z ∘ σ) hIz;
                    ⟨hd,
                      ⟨hn,
                        id

                            (id

                                (fun _a =>
                                  SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue _a =
                                    SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue

                                (congrArg
                                  (fun _a =>
                                    SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue
                                        ((z ∘ σ) (DiamondIntegral.Section4.FiniteTupleBlocks.tailIndex 1 r.arity 0)) =
                                      SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.codeValue (τ.aperture _a))
                                  (Eq.symm hzh)))
                              (le_antisymm hle hge)))⟩⟩ })))
    hpre

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

    z ∈ H.target.carrier ∧ ∃ p ∈ C.carrier, ∀ (i : Fin r), p.2 i = z.2 (H.oldLabels i) :=

  {

      Exists.casesOn a fun p h =>
        h ▸
          ⟨(H.lift.toFun ⟨↑p, hC.left p.property⟩).property,
            Exists.intro ↑p ⟨p.property, fun i => Eq.symm (H.retained ⟨↑p, hC.left p.property⟩ i)⟩⟩,
    mpr := fun a =>
      And.casesOn a fun hz right =>

          And.casesOn h fun hp hpz =>
            Exists.casesOn (Function.Bijective.surjective H.home.bijective ⟨z, hz⟩) fun p' hp' =>
              have hlab :=
                funext fun i =>

                      (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => z.2 (H.oldLabels i) = (↑_a).2 (H.oldLabels i)) hp'))
                        (Eq.refl (z.2 (H.oldLabels i)))));
              have hp'C := hC.right p (hC.left hp) (↑p') p'.property hlab hp;
              Exists.intro ⟨↑p', hp'C⟩ (congrArg Subtype.val hp') }

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.RestrictContractions.restrict_bundle : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G : Type} [inst_2 : LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G]
  [inst_3 : Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {S : Set M} {n r : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + 1) r) S}
  (H : DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage A)
  (C : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + 1) r) S)
  (hC : DiamondIntegral.Section7.RestrictContractions.LabelSaturated C A),
  (H.lift.restrict ⋯).image.carrier =
    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.rvCoordinateBundle (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfDropLast (H.lift.restrict ⋯).image).image
        H.leading).carrier :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G}
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {S} {n r} {A} H C hC =>
  Set.ext fun z =>
    id
      {
        mp := fun hz =>
          ⟨Exists.intro ⟨z, hz⟩ rfl,
            ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage.recover_target H z).mp
                (DiamondIntegral.Section7.RestrictContractions.restrictTarget_subset H C hC hz)).right⟩,
        mpr := fun a =>
          And.casesOn a fun left hrv =>
            Exists.casesOn left fun w hw =>
              have h1 :=
                have h := congrArg Prod.fst hw;
                h;
              have h2 :=
                have h := congrArg Prod.snd hw;
                h;
              And.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.RestrictContractions.mem_restrictTarget H C hC ↑w).mp w.property)
                fun hwH right =>
                Exists.casesOn right fun p h =>
                  And.casesOn h fun hp hpl =>
                    (DiamondIntegral.Section7.RestrictContractions.mem_restrictTarget H C hC z).mpr
                      ⟨(DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage.recover_target H z).mpr
                          ⟨have h :=
                              ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage.recover_target H ↑w).mp hwH).left;
                            Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => (Fin.init z.1, _a) ∈ H.contracted.carrier) h2)
                              (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => (_a, (↑w).2) ∈ H.contracted.carrier) h1) h),
                            hrv⟩,
                        Exists.intro p
                          ⟨hp, fun i =>
                            Eq.trans (hpl i)
                              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a (H.oldLabels i) = z.2 (H.oldLabels i)) h2))
                                (Eq.refl (z.2 (H.oldLabels i))))⟩⟩ }

  have hpA := hC.left p.property;
  have hpE := fun h => hp ⟨h, p.property⟩;
  Exists.casesOn (H.unitDerivative ⟨↑p, hpA⟩ hpE) fun L h =>
    And.casesOn h fun left hdet =>
      Exists.casesOn left fun Fc h =>
        And.casesOn h fun left hD =>
          Exists.casesOn left fun ρ hρ =>
            Exists.intro L
              ⟨Exists.intro Fc
                  ⟨Exists.intro ρ fun x hx =>
                      Exists.casesOn (hρ x hx) fun hxA hxF =>
                        Exists.intro (hC.right (↑p) hpA (x, (↑p).2) hxA rfl p.property) hxF,
                    hD⟩,
                hdet⟩

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.RestrictContractions.prepared_saturated : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S : Set M} {n r : ℕ}
  {A : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + 1) r) S}
  (D : DiamondIntegral.Section6.ZeroCenteredData A) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1)))
  (C : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (n + 1) r) S)
  (hC : DiamondIntegral.Section7.RestrictContractions.LabelSaturated C A)
  (hCp : DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperInvariant S C.carrier),
  DiamondIntegral.Section7.RestrictContractions.LabelSaturated
    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.reindexedVFSet
      (DiamondIntegral.Section7.RestrictContractions.restrictCentered D C hC hCp).map.image e)
    (DiamondIntegral.Section6.reindexedVFSet D.map.image e) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n r} {A} D e C hC hCp =>
  ⟨fun y hy =>
    Exists.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.RestrictContractions.mem_prepared_restrict D e C hC hCp y).mp hy)
      fun p h =>
      And.casesOn h fun hp he =>
        (DiamondIntegral.Section7.RestrictContractions.mem_prepared D e y).mpr (Exists.intro p ⟨hC.left hp, he⟩),
    fun y x y' hy' hyy hyC =>
    Exists.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.RestrictContractions.mem_prepared_restrict D e C hC hCp y).mp hyC)
      fun p h =>
      And.casesOn h fun hp he =>
        Exists.casesOn ((DiamondIntegral.Section7.RestrictContractions.mem_prepared D e y').mp hy') fun p' h =>
          And.casesOn h fun hp' he' =>
            have hlab :=
              funext fun i =>
                have h1 := congrArg (fun z => z.2 (Fin.natAdd (n + 1) i)) he;
                have h2 := congrArg (fun z => z.2 (Fin.natAdd (n + 1) i)) he';
                Eq.mpr
                  (id
                    (congrArg (fun _a => _a = p'.2 i)
                      (Eq.mp
                        (congrFun'
                          (congrArg Eq
                            (Fin.append_right (fun i => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core p i)) p.2 i))
                          (y.2 (Fin.natAdd (n + 1) i)))
                        h1)))
                  (Eq.mpr
                    (id
                      (congrArg (fun _a => y.2 (Fin.natAdd (n + 1) i) = _a)
                        (Eq.mp
                          (congrFun'
                            (congrArg Eq
                              (Fin.append_right (fun i => DiamondIntegral.Section6.branchTag (D.core p' i)) p'.2 i))
                            (y'.2 (Fin.natAdd (n + 1) i)))
                          h2)))
                    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a (Fin.natAdd (n + 1) i) = y'.2 (Fin.natAdd (n + 1) i)) hyy))
                      (Eq.refl (y'.2 (Fin.natAdd (n + 1) i)))));
            (DiamondIntegral.Section7.RestrictContractions.mem_prepared_restrict D e C hC hCp y').mpr
              (Exists.intro p' ⟨hC.right p (hC.left hp) p' hp' hlab hp, he'⟩)⟩

@DiamondIntegral.Section7.SliceStages.defSet_eq : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  {P : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV M} {T : Set M}
  {A A' : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet P T}, A'.carrier = A.carrier → A' = A
theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.SliceStages.defSet_eq : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  {P : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.Space SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV M} {T : Set M}
  {A A' : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet P T}, A'.carrier = A.carrier → A' = A :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] {P} {T} {A A'} h =>
  SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.casesOn (motive := fun t => A = t → A' = A) A
    (fun carrier definable h_1 =>
      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {A} => A'.carrier = A.carrier → A' = A)
        (fun h =>
          SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet.casesOn (motive := fun t =>
            A' = t → A' = { carrier := carrier, definable := definable }) A'
            (fun carrier_1 definable_1 h_2 =>
              Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {A'} =>
                A'.carrier = { carrier := carrier, definable := definable }.carrier →
                  A' = { carrier := carrier, definable := definable })
                (fun h =>
                  Eq.casesOn (motive := fun a t =>
                    { carrier := carrier, definable := definable }.carrier = a →
                      h ≍ t →
                        { carrier := carrier_1, definable := definable_1 } =
                          { carrier := carrier, definable := definable })
                    h
                    (fun h_3 =>
                      Eq.ndrec (motive := fun carrier_2 =>
                        ∀ (definable_2 : P.Definable T carrier_2)
                          (h :
                            { carrier := carrier_2, definable := definable_2 }.carrier =
                              { carrier := carrier, definable := definable }.carrier),
                          h ≍ Eq.refl { carrier := carrier_2, definable := definable_2 }.carrier →
                            { carrier := carrier_2, definable := definable_2 } =
                              { carrier := carrier, definable := definable })
                        (fun definable_2 h h_4 => Eq.refl { carrier := carrier, definable := definable_2 }) h_3
                        definable_1 h)
                    (Eq.refl { carrier := carrier, definable := definable }.carrier) (HEq.refl h))
                (Eq.symm h_2) h)
            (Eq.refl A'))
        (Eq.symm h_1) h)
    (Eq.refl A)

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.SpecialChainSplit.mem_reg_res : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {n r : ℕ} {T : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Substructure M}
  {X : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) ↑T}
  (J : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawRVSpace r) ↑T)
  {q : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M n (n + r)},
  q ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularizeMap (DiamondIntegral.Section6.focusActive X J)).image.carrier ↔
    q ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularizeMap X).image.carrier ∧ (fun i => q.2 (Fin.natAdd n i)) ∈ J.carrier :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n r}
    {T} {X} J {q} =>
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg
        (fun _a =>
          _a ↔
            q ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularizeMap X).image.carrier ∧ (fun i => q.2 (Fin.natAdd n i)) ∈ J.carrier)
        (propext (DiamondIntegral.Section7.SpecialChains.mem_regularize (DiamondIntegral.Section6.focusActive X J)))))
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a =>
            (∃ p ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.focusActive X J).carrier, DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularize p = q) ↔
              _a ∧ (fun i => q.2 (Fin.natAdd n i)) ∈ J.carrier)
          (propext (DiamondIntegral.Section7.SpecialChains.mem_regularize X))))
      {
        mp := fun a =>
          Exists.casesOn a fun p h =>
            And.casesOn h fun hp right =>
              right ▸
                ⟨Exists.intro p ⟨hp.left, rfl⟩,
                  have he := funext fun i => DiamondIntegral.Section7.SpecialChains.regularize_snd_right p i;
                  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ J.carrier) he)) hp.right⟩,
        mpr := fun a =>
          And.casesOn a fun left hJ =>
            Exists.casesOn left fun p h =>
              And.casesOn h fun hp right =>
                Eq.ndrec (motive := fun {q} =>
                  (fun i => q.2 (Fin.natAdd n i)) ∈ J.carrier →
                    ∃ p ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.focusActive X J).carrier, DiamondIntegral.Section6.regularize p = q)
                  (fun hJ =>
                    have he := funext fun i => DiamondIntegral.Section7.SpecialChains.regularize_snd_right p i;
                    Exists.intro p ⟨⟨hp, Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ J.carrier) he) hJ⟩, rfl⟩)
                  right hJ })

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.SpecialChains.zc_core_false : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {S : Set M} {n r : ℕ}
  {X : SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace n r) S}
  (Z : DiamondIntegral.Section6.ZeroCenteredData X),
  DiamondIntegral.Section6.VFDoublyBounded X.carrier →
    ∀ {p : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M n r}, p ∈ X.carrier → ∀ (i : Fin n), Z.core p i = false :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {S}
    {n r} {X} Z hD {p} hp i =>
  Decidable.byContradiction fun h =>
    have hlt := of_decide_eq_true (Bool.eq_true_of_not_eq_false h);
    let y := Function.update p.1 i 0;
    have hcong := fun l =>
      if hl : l = i then
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg
              (fun _a =>
                ↑((fun x => DiamondIntegral.Section2.finiteValue Z.center Z.center_nonzero) _a) <
                  DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (p.1 _a - y _a))
              hl))
          (id
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue Z.center < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (p.1 i - _a))
                  (Function.update_self i 0 p.1)))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue Z.center < DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue _a)
                    (sub_zero (p.1 i))))
                hlt)))
      else
        id
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section2.finiteValue Z.center Z.center_nonzero) <
                    SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom (p.1 l - _a))
                (Function.update_of_ne hl 0 p.1)))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg
                  (fun _a =>
                    ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section2.finiteValue Z.center Z.center_nonzero) <
                      SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.vfValueHom _a)
                  (sub_self (p.1 l))))

theorem DiamondIntegral.Section7.StageReindexing.det_conj : ∀ {M : Type}
  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [inst_1 : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {n : ℕ} (s : Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
  (L : (Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) →ₗ[DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M] Fin n → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
  (LinearMap.toMatrix' L).det = 1 →
    (LinearMap.toMatrix'
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfReindexLinear s ∘ₗ
            L ∘ₗ DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfReindexLinear (Equiv.symm s))).det =
      1 :=

    hL =>
  have hsc := congrArg (fun D => (LinearMap.toMatrix' D).det) (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfReindexLinear_symm_comp s);
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg (fun _a => _a.det = 1)

        (congrArg (fun _a => (LinearMap.toMatrix' (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfReindexLinear s) * _a).det = 1)
          (LinearMap.toMatrix'_comp L (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfReindexLinear (Equiv.symm s)))))
      (Eq.mpr

        (Eq.mpr

              (Matrix.det_mul (LinearMap.toMatrix' L)
                (LinearMap.toMatrix' (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfReindexLinear (Equiv.symm s))))))
          (Eq.mpr

              (congrArg
                (fun _a =>
                  (LinearMap.toMatrix' (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfReindexLinear s)).det *
                      (_a * (LinearMap.toMatrix' (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfReindexLinear (Equiv.symm s))).det) =
                    1)

              (Eq.mp
                (congr
                  (congrArg Eq
                    (Eq.trans

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

            SpecialTransformations.Section3.Saturated M κ →
              (∀ (x y : DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M),
                  SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.VFValued.predV x y ↔ Valued.v x ≤ Valued.v y) →
                ∀ {S : Set M},
                  Cardinal.mk ↑S < κ →
                    DiamondIntegral.Section2.NontrivialDefinableGamma { real := S, gamma := ∅ } →

                        {Y :
                          SpecialTransformations.DefinableGeometry.DefSet
                            (SpecialTransformations.Section4.rawMixedSpace (N + 1) r) S}
                        (H : DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage Y) (s : Equiv.Perm (Fin (N + 1)))
                        (p : ↑(DiamondIntegral.Section6.reindexedVFSet Y s).carrier),
                        ↑p ∉ (DiamondIntegral.Section6.reindexedVFSet H.exceptional s).carrier →
                          DiamondIntegral.Section6.HasMixedUnitDerivativeAt
                            (DiamondIntegral.Section7.StageReindexing.reindexLift H s) p :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G}
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] h00 hc linear {κ} hκ hs hv {S} hsmall
    hΓ {N r} {Y} H s p hp =>
  have hY :=
    DiamondIntegral.Section6.ProperCovariant.source_properInvariant h00 hc linear hκ hs hv hsmall hΓ H.home.covariant;
  let q :=
    ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfRelabeling Y s).inverse (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfRelabeling_bijective Y s)).toFun p;
  have hq := fun hqE =>
    hp
      ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.mem_reindexedVFSet H.exceptional s ↑p).mpr
        (have he := Eq.symm (DiamondIntegral.Section7.StageReindexing.relabel_inverse_value Y s p);
        Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => _a ∈ H.exceptional.carrier) he)) hqE));

    And.casesOn h fun hL hdet =>
      have h1 := DiamondIntegral.Section7.StageReindexing.relabel_inverse_derivative hv Y s hY p;
      have h2 :=
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.mixedDerivative_comp
          ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfRelabeling Y s).inverse (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfRelabeling_bijective Y s))
          H.lift p h1 hL;
      have h3 :=
        DiamondIntegral.Section6.mixedDerivative_comp
          (H.lift.comp
            ((DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfRelabeling Y s).inverse (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfRelabeling_bijective Y s)))
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfRelabeling H.target s) p h2
          (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfRelabeling_derivative hv H.target s H.proper (H.lift.toFun q));
      Exists.intro
        (DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfReindexLinear s ∘ₗ L ∘ₗ DiamondIntegral.Section6.vfReindexLinear (Equiv.symm s))
        ⟨h3, DiamondIntegral.Section7.StageReindexing.det_conj s L hdet⟩

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

  (H : DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage Y) (b : Fin m → DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M)
  (hS : S ∪ Set.range (SpecialTransformations.Section4.vfValues b) ⊆ S')
  (p : DiamondIntegral.Section2.Mixed M 1 H.arity),
  p ∈ (DiamondIntegral.Section7.FibreRestriction.sliceSet H.target b hS).carrier ↔
    (b, p.2) ∈ H.contracted.carrier ∧ DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (p.1 0) = p.2 H.leading :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {G}
    [LinearOrderedCommGroupWithZero G] [Valued (DiamondIntegral.Section2.VF M) G] {S S'} {m r} {Y} H b hS p =>
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg (fun _a => _a ↔ (b, p.2) ∈ H.contracted.carrier ∧ DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (p.1 0) = p.2 H.leading)
        (propext (DiamondIntegral.Section7.FibreRestriction.mem_sliceSet p))))
    (Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg
          (fun _a => _a ↔ (b, p.2) ∈ H.contracted.carrier ∧ DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M (p.1 0) = p.2 H.leading)
          (propext (DiamondIntegral.Section6.StandardContractionStage.recover_target H (Fin.snoc b (p.1 0), p.2)))))
      {
        mp := fun a =>
          And.casesOn a fun h1 h2 =>
            ⟨Eq.mp
                (congrArg (Membership.mem H.contracted.carrier)
                  (congrFun' (congrArg Prod.mk (Fin.init_snoc (p.1 0) b)) p.2))
                h1,
              have h := h2;
              Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M _a = p.2 H.leading) (Fin.snoc_last (p.1 0) b))
                h⟩,
        mpr := fun a =>
          And.casesOn a fun h1 h2 =>
            ⟨Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (Membership.mem H.contracted.carrier)
                    (congrFun' (congrArg Prod.mk (Fin.init_snoc (p.1 0) b)) p.2)))
                h1,
              id
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id (congrArg (fun _a => DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv M _a = p.2 H.leading) (Fin.snoc_last (p.1 0) b)))
                  h2)⟩ })

    {t₁ t₂} h x y =>

      have hx := Exists.intro (x, y) ⟨hxy, rfl⟩;
      have hy := hxy;
      Exists.casesOn (Eq.mp (congrArg (fun _a => y ∈ _a) (h.fibre_eq x hx)) hy) fun s h =>

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [hM : M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]

    {

        have hfib := DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoCells.fibre_of_zero_left h h1 ha;
        Exists.casesOn (DiamondIntegral.Section2.rv_surjective t₂) fun s hs =>

  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]

    DiamondIntegral.Section6.Congruent α (Fin.snoc (Fin.snoc b (x 0)) (x 1)) (Fin.snoc (Fin.snoc b (y 0)) (y 1)) :=
fun {M} [SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M] [M ⊨ SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF] {m} {b}
    {α} {x y} h i =>
  Fin.lastCases
    (have h1 := h 1;
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (Eq.trans
          (congrArg (LT.lt ↑(α (Fin.last (m + 1))))
            (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue
              (congr (congrArg HSub.hSub (Fin.snoc_last (x 1) (Fin.snoc b (x 0))))
                (Fin.snoc_last (y 1) (Fin.snoc b (y 0))))))
          gt_iff_lt._simp_1))
      (Eq.mp
        (congrFun'
          (congrArg LT.lt (congrArg Subtype.val (congrArg α DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoDimSlices.natAdd_two_one)))
          (DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (x 1 - y 1)))
        h1))
    (fun j =>
      Fin.lastCases
        (have h0 := h 0;
        Eq.mpr
          (id
            (Eq.trans
              (congrArg (LT.lt ↑(α (Fin.last m).castSucc))
                (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue
                  (congr
                    (congrArg HSub.hSub
                      (Eq.trans (Fin.snoc_castSucc (x 1) (Fin.snoc b (x 0)) (Fin.last m)) (Fin.snoc_last (x 0) b)))
                    (Eq.trans (Fin.snoc_castSucc (y 1) (Fin.snoc b (y 0)) (Fin.last m)) (Fin.snoc_last (y 0) b)))))
              gt_iff_lt._simp_1))
          (Eq.mp
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg LT.lt (congrArg Subtype.val (congrArg α DiamondIntegral.Section7.TwoDimSlices.natAdd_two_zero)))
              (DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue (x 0 - y 0)))
            h0))
        (fun k =>
          Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (LT.lt ↑(α k.castSucc.castSucc))
                (Eq.trans
                  (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue
                    (Eq.trans
                      (congr
                        (congrArg HSub.hSub
                          (Eq.trans (Fin.snoc_castSucc (x 1) (Fin.snoc b (x 0)) k.castSucc)
                            (Fin.snoc_castSucc (x 0) b k)))
                        (Eq.trans (Fin.snoc_castSucc (y 1) (Fin.snoc b (y 0)) k.castSucc)
                          (Fin.snoc_castSucc (y 0) b k)))
                      (sub_self (b k))))
                  DiamondIntegral.Section6.value_zero)))
            (Eq.mp
              (congrArg (LT.lt ↑(α k.castSucc.castSucc))
                (Eq.trans
                  (congrArg DiamondIntegral.Section2.vfValue
                    (Eq.trans
                      (congr
                        (congrArg HSub.hSub
                          (Eq.trans (Fin.snoc_castSucc (x 1) (Fin.snoc b (x 0)) k.castSucc)
                            (Fin.snoc_castSucc (x 0) b k)))

              (DiamondIntegral.Section6.Congruent.refl α (Fin.snoc (Fin.snoc b (x 0)) (x 1)) k.castSucc.castSucc)))
